mobShortDesc: Here stands an Ancient Mummy , his only purpose is to protect the SPHINX!
mobLongDesc: Here stands a mummy about 1000 years old. His wraps are tattered and torn from centuries of protecting the Sphinx from the likes of you!

mobShortDesc: Crawling about the ground is a Two hundred year old snake
mobLongDesc: On the ground in front of you crawls a 200 year old snake. The snake appears to be unaffected by time. Although he has no arms or legs his attack can be lethal!

mobShortDesc: A vampire bat hangs from the ceiling.
mobLongDesc: Hanging from the ceiling is a vampire bat. His only source of food being unwary passer by's. So you best be careful!

mobShortDesc: An ancient egyptian priest is praying here.
mobLongDesc: Standing in front of you blocking your way is an ancient priest not less than 1000 years old. From the looks of it you have intruded on something.

mobShortDesc: Here stands the mummy of Tutankhamen.
mobLongDesc: Here stands the mummy of the great pharaoh Tutankhamen. He is thousands of years old and really shows his age. He looks like an easy kill, but then things aren't always what they seem!

mobShortDesc: Here stands the first mummy of the Sphinx.
mobLongDesc: This is the first mummy you have found in the Sphinx. His wraps are tattered and torn , and he appears to have been here for centuries!

mobShortDesc: Here stands the second mummy of the Sphinx
mobLongDesc: Here stands the second ancient mummy. He is much like the first one you encountered. His wraps are tattered and torn from centuries of aging.

mobShortDesc: Here stands the third mummy of the Sphinx
mobLongDesc: You are looking at the third mummy of this ancient Sphinx. He looks much like the other mummies you have seen. He looks old and worn, but thousands of years has that affect.

mobShortDesc: An electric eel swims here, ready to take a bite out of your hide!
mobLongDesc: This eel is nearly six feet long!  It is covered with dark gray scales and the sewage seems to have stained them in certain places.  It looks like it is a very mean fellow, but takes little notice of you.  The teeth on it do look very dangerous and small arcs of electricity can be seen every so often.

mobShortDesc: A mound of garbage rises and attacks!
mobLongDesc: This mound of garbage looks utterly disgusting and smells worse than anything you have ever smelled before.  It has bits of trash and garbage composing its skin and the remains of old weapons and armor can be seen, sharp as ever.

mobShortDesc: A large mass of slime floats here.
mobLongDesc: It's green and looks like a giant mound of slime.
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST

mobShortDesc: A small doll lies here, waiting to attack an unfortunate victim.
mobLongDesc: This evil looking thing resembles a small doll crafted to look very much like a living being.  You almost swear you recognize the face, but as soon as you almost get there, it seems to swirl and take on a new image. There are obvious stitches covering its body and its eyes seem to look right through you.
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST

mobShortDesc: A zombie that looks like a halfling wanders about.
mobLongDesc: This creature looks like an undead version of a halfling.  It is short and looks relatively weak, yet reeks of zombie flesh.  It moans occasionally and it's grey twisted flesh is only covered by some tattered rags.  It's mouth is stink.

mobShortDesc: The faint outline of a holy knight hovers here, searching for something.
mobLongDesc: This shining figure looks like it is searching for someone, or something. His face has an expression of pure sadness and he gazes at you, longing to ask for help, yet no words come from him mouth.  From the faint outline of his body that is visible, he looks like one of the famous paladins of Midgaard that has met his untimely demise too soon.
affectedByFlags: INVISIBLE SENSE-LIFE SANCTUARY SPHERE PROTECT-EVIL DODGE PROTECT-GOOD INVUL

mobShortDesc: A golem made of rotting garbage rises from the floor.
mobLongDesc: This golem is constructed from the various debris found within the sewers. It reeks of garbage and is completely silent and doesn't seem to like the fact that you stand before it.  The trash that composes its body has begun to rot and the mere thought of touching it makes you sick.

mobShortDesc: A cleric is here, worshiping the god of garbage.
mobLongDesc: This cleric is dressed in dark green robes stained with garbage and raw sewage. Her symbol appears to be to the god of garbage and she smells as bad as the rest of this place.  Upon closer inspection, her face seems rotted, almost to the point of undead texture, yet she maintains some human features, such as hair and eyelids.
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST

mobShortDesc: This pile of trash reeks of toxic fumes!
mobLongDesc: This pile of trash has been constructed to resemble a humanoid form.  It wears some basic armor and wields nothing but its fists.  Its construction reminds you of a scarecrow.  Needless to say, this fellow reeks of pure garbage.

mobShortDesc: A Brigand is standing here.
mobLongDesc: The brigand is a wiry figure with a face hardened by years of living on the edge of the law. His patchy leather armor is mismatched and poorly maintained, but it bears the marks of countless skirmishes. A crooked grin reveals yellowed teeth as he sizes you up, a wickedly sharp dagger glinting in his hand. His unkempt hair and the faint smell of ale suggest a life of indulgence and desperation. Despite his disheveled appearance, his movements are quick and calculated, like a predator waiting for the perfect moment to strike.

mobShortDesc: Calanar the Brigand Champion eyes you suspiciously.
mobLongDesc: A towering figure of muscle and menace, Calanar is Kulzarens right hand and enforcer. His armor, a patchwork of salvaged plate and chainmail, is battered but functional, and his greatsworda brutal, jagged weaponrests against his back, its hilt wrapped in worn leather. Calanars face is a mask of stoic resolve, his piercing gaze betraying no emotion. Scars crisscross his arms and neck, each a trophy from a battle hard-fought. In combat, Calanar is relentless, his blows landing with terrifying precision and power. He fights not for glory but for loyalty to Kulzaren, and his mere presence on the battlefield inspires fear and obedience in equal measure.

mobShortDesc: A travelling merchant standing here eyeing you fondly.
mobLongDesc: The merchant is a charismatic wanderer clad in vibrant garments adorned with trinkets from distant lands. His weathered face is framed by a bushy beard, and his bright, mischievous eyes sparkle with the promise of exotic wares. A large wagon, overflowing with goods, follows him wherever he goes, its sides painted with bold patterns. He speaks with a lilting accent, spinning tales of adventure and mystery as he showcases his wares everything from shimmering silks and rare spices to peculiar relics and enchanted baubles. His charm is infectious, and its hard to tell whether hes a cunning trader or simply a man with a love for life and the open road.

mobShortDesc: Sadyra is here making strange gestures over a bubbling cauldron.
mobLongDesc: Sadyra is a commanding figure draped in flowing robes of black and crimson, embroidered with arcane symbols that seem to writhe and shift when viewed from the corner of the eye. Her striking, pale face is framed by jet-black hair streaked with silver, and her piercing eyes glow faintly with a violet hue, betraying the immense magical power she wields. A gnarled staff topped with a dark crystal rests in her hand, pulsating with an ominous energy. The air around her is heavy with the scent of burnt herbs and the faint crackle of magical static. Sadyras voice is smooth and commanding, each word imbued with the power to compel or destroy. At her side, the spectral spirits serve as both advisors and guardians, reinforcing her aura of eldritch authority.
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST

mobShortDesc: A Spirit is floating in front of you.
mobLongDesc: These spectral beings radiate an unsettling, otherworldly presence. Their forms are semi-transparent, shimmering faintly with hues of blue and green. Their faces are obscured, as though shrouded in mist, but their hollow eyes seem to pierce through to ones very soul. Their movements are slow and deliberate, as if weighed down by the ethereal chains of their past lives. Faint whispers emanate from them, fragments of language both haunting and unintelligible. They sit silently beside Sadyra, their posture reverent yet menacing, as if awaiting her command or observing with otherworldly patience.

mobShortDesc: Marvick, Kulzaren's Aide is standing here.
mobLongDesc: He is a wiry man with a sharp tongue and a sharper mind. His ink stained fingers are always busy sketching battle plans or counting stolen coin. Though unassuming, his piercing eyes miss nothing, and his knowledge of the land makes him invaluable.

mobShortDesc: Kulzaren the leader of the brigand glares at you from atop his throne.
mobLongDesc: Kulzaren exudes a commanding presence, his tall, broad-shouldered frame accentuated by a cloak of deep crimson edged with tarnished thread. His sharp, angular face is shadowed by a perpetual scowl, and a deep scar runs from his temple to his jaw, a grim reminder of his ruthless rise to power. His voice carries an air of authority, smooth yet edged with a venom that makes lesser men tremble. He wields an ornate longsword with an ebony hilt, its blade etched with faint, glowing runes. Despite his rough surroundings, Kulzarens cunning and charisma set him apart, and the air around him feels charged with the weight of his ambition.

mobShortDesc: A Wizard is standing here.
mobLongDesc: The wizard is an elderly figure wrapped in layers of deep blue and silver robes, each embroidered with intricate constellations and arcane glyphs. His long, snowy beard cascades down his chest, contrasting sharply with the sharp, lively glint in his piercing grey eyes. A wide brimmed hat adorned with a single raven feather rests atop his head, and a crystal topped staff is always within reach, glowing faintly with an inner light. The air around him crackles with latent energy, and the faint scent of incense clings to his robes. Despite his age, his movements are deliberate and precise, and his voice carries the weight of centuries of knowledge. His shop is a labyrinth of scrolls, tomes, and magical artifacts, all watched over by an ever present owl familiar perched on his shoulder.

mobShortDesc: A Blacksmith is here welcoming you to his shop.
mobLongDesc: The blacksmith is a burly man with arms as thick as tree trunks and a chest scarred by the stray sparks of his trade. His face is tanned and weathered, framed by a short, bristly beard flecked with soot. He wears a heavy leather apron over a simple linen shirt, both darkened by years of forge work. His voice is deep and gravelly, and his laugh, though rare, is hearty. The smithy smells of hot iron and coal, and the rhythmic clang of his hammer against anvil is a constant sound. Racks of weapons, armor, and tools line the walls, each piece a testament to his craftsmanship. Despite his gruff exterior, his sharp eyes reveal a keen mind and a quiet pride in his work.

mobShortDesc: The Baker is standing here.
mobLongDesc: The baker is a plump, cheerful man with flour-dusted hands and a perpetual smile. His face is round and ruddy, framed by a cropped beard and a shock of unruly hair tucked beneath a well worn cap. He moves with practiced ease between the ovens and the counters, pulling trays of fresh bread, pies, and pastries that fill the air with a heavenly aroma. The bakery itself is warm and inviting, its wooden shelves laden with golden loaves and sweet confections. A faint layer of flour seems to cover everything, from the counters to the bakers apron. His hearty laugh is as welcoming as the treats he sells, and he greets each customer like an old friend.

mobShortDesc: A Shopkeeper is standing here.
mobLongDesc: The shopkeeper is a shrewd individual, always ready with a deal or a clever remark. Dressed in simple but tidy clothes, his sharp eyes and quick hands make it clear that little escapes his notice. His general store is a jumble of goods ranging from sacks of grain to bolts of fabric, with shelves creaking under the weight of a hundred small, essential items. A well-worn abacus sits on the counter, alongside a small box that clinks with coins as he deftly counts change. His voice is smooth and persuasive, and he has a knack for convincing customers that they need just one more item before they leave.

mobShortDesc: A Brigand Guard stands at his post.
mobLongDesc: The brigand guard is a hulking brute, clearly the muscle of the operation. His armor is cobbled together from stolen chainmail and dented iron plates, giving him a rough but formidable appearance. A massive club rests across his shoulder, its surface marred with dark stains from previous battles. His scarred face is devoid of humor, and his eyes gleam with a mix of suspicion and cruelty. The air around him feels heavy with menace, and his booming voice barks commands to lesser brigands, ensuring they stay in line. He stands ready to defend his crew with ruthless efficiency, daring anyone to challenge him.

mobShortDesc: Vessara, Kulzaren's Aide is standing here.
mobLongDesc: She is a quiet and deadly figure, clad in dark leathers that allow her to vanish into the night. Her daggers gleam with a faint, poisonous sheen, and her whispers often carry more weight than the loudest orders. Together, they ensure Kulzarens plans are carried out with precision, their loyalty born of fear as much as respect.

mobShortDesc: A huge bear of a man stands here with arms crossed, blocking your way.
mobLongDesc: A huge burly man stands tall before you, eyes gazing down trying to make you feel meek.  He is the bouncer of this luxurious establishment, guarding these doors making sure the right people go in and the wrong ones don't.  So don't mess with him, he looks like he has had a very bad day.

mobShortDesc: A Restaurant Attendant sits here diligently waiting on your next order.
mobLongDesc: Dressed in a nicely pressed suit, this elegant looking attendant sits here casually blowing bubble gum.  She waits here impatiently for you to order something, but doesn't seen to care much because she gets paid whether or not you receive your food.

mobShortDesc: A waiter is here, making sure that you are enjoying your stay.
mobLongDesc: A full suit and a pair of thick glasses droop slightly over his nose, this clean-shaven man nods as if annoyed as he swiftly walks over and cleans the tables.  He works long, hard hours -- an expression of boredom is visible on his face, making you wonder if he deserves your tip or not.

mobShortDesc: A waitress is standing here smiling broadly.
mobLongDesc: A bright smile beams on her cute face as she trips over her own feet. Giggling at her own bad luck, Beatrice straightens out her formal dress attire and proceeds to clean tables.

mobShortDesc: The evil Warlock Aldor is here, summoning evil.
mobLongDesc: Aldor is an evil looking man.  Let's not make him angry.

mobShortDesc: A Small Wyvern is flying here.
mobLongDesc: The wyvern is very small so he should not cause you too much trouble.

mobShortDesc: The Spirit of Edrick's Guard is here, haunting the Castle.
mobLongDesc: This spirit was once a mighty guard for the great king Edrick, but now it haunts the halls of this old castle.

mobShortDesc: An Old Cook is standing here.
mobLongDesc: She once cooked for the great Edrick, but now she is a slave of the evil Aldor.

mobShortDesc: A rat is here, running about the floor.
mobLongDesc: The rat is a small brown rodent, kinda cute actually.

mobShortDesc: A Flying Dragon is here, waiting for is master.
mobLongDesc: This mighty dragon is the pet of the evil Aldor.  It looks very strong and powerful.

mobShortDesc: An Animated Knight is here, protecting Aldor.
mobLongDesc: You look at the knight, only  notice it is an empty suit of armor. Aldor is truly powerful to create such a beast.

mobShortDesc: A Prisoner of Aldor is standing here.
mobLongDesc: This man, once a loyal follower of Edrick, is now confined to a cell by the evil Aldor.

mobShortDesc: A Priestess is here making offerings for Aldor.
mobLongDesc: This young girl was once a follower of Edrick, but now Aldor has her making offerings to him as the price of her continuing existence.

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls II, by Liner
mobShortDesc: An insectile creature scuttles quickly to meet you, ample jaws spreading wide.
mobLongDesc: A towering, brown insect extends its grasping appendages toward you as its ample mandibles snap back and forth in the air, oozing saliva.  These creatures have taken over the ancient mines as their own, and you have happened upon their nest. Its tenuous gaze flicks over your body as it rapidly approaches.

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls II, by Liner
mobShortDesc: The sorrowful vision of a lost soul passes quickly before you.
mobLongDesc: A lonely apparition glides effortlessly along the subterranean breeze. It appears to be the soul of a would-be adventurer, one of the many who became lost or met with some unnatural death in these endless caverns.  It gently caresses your shoulder and conveys the deep sorrow buried within its translucent eyes.

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls II, by Liner
mobName: The soul of a mining slave
mobShortDesc: A wispy image of a miner flashes briefly across the wall.
mobLongDesc: The departed soul of an ancient mining slave floats neatly along the ground as if walking.  It carries a pickaxe and a dim candle in its wispy hands.  A ghostly echo of a whistle drifts to your ears as it returns to whatever spectral work it was consumed with before you arrived.

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls II, by Liner
mobShortDesc: The sorrowful vision of a lost soul passes quickly before you.
mobLongDesc: A lonely apparition glides effortlessly along the subterranean breeze. It appears to be the soul of a would-be adventurer, one of the many who became lost or met with some unnatural death in these endless caverns.  It gently caresses your shoulder and conveys the deep sorrow buried within its translucent eyes.

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls II, by Liner
mobShortDesc: A broken spirit trembles like a leaf in the soft breeze.
mobLongDesc: A disembodied figure floats briefly into your field of vision. Cowering away, it tucks its tattered shape of a head under its arm and begins such an unearthly whimper that your ears fairly ring. It appears to be larger than the other spiritual inhabitants of these caves and in such torment that no man could ever endure.
mobImmune: FIRE ELECTRIC PUMMEL KICK PUNCH BACKSTAB AMBUSH ASSAULT

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls II, by Liner
mobShortDesc: The raging spirit of an ancient horror turns to slay you in its gaze.
mobLongDesc: A blood-spackled spectre unfurls its tenebrous shrouds as you approach. Its form is long and sleek, eyes blazing deep scarlet and teeth elongating to the likeness of needles. Its anger is apparent as it rushes to dispatch of you.
mobImmune: FIRE ELECTRIC PUMMEL KICK PUNCH BACKSTAB AMBUSH ASSAULT

mobLongDesc: A towering, brown insect extends its grasping appendages toward you as its ample mandibles snap back and forth in the air, oozing saliva.  These creatures have taken over the ancient mines as their own, and you have happened upon their nest. Its tenuous gaze flicks over your body as it rapidly approaches.

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls I, by Liner
mobShortDesc: A writhing vine slips out of the overgrowth and taps you tentatively.
mobLongDesc: The languid extension of the surrounding overgrowth dips forward to probe its environment.  Ganoid scales like the surface of this alien plant, and murderous thorns jut out to hold its prey.  Almost with a mind of its own, its tip aligns with your eyes and whips forward to attack!

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls I, by Liner
mobShortDesc: Tajjo, emissary of death, wanders these burrows leaving a trail of poisoned earth.
mobLongDesc: A silent, human-like form regards you with disdain as you invade the recesses of his domain.  He is the bane of existence, a demon with only one purpose to serve, and that is death itself.  His face breaks into a demented snarl as he saunters forth to claim your mortal soul and condemn you to these catacombs for eternity.
mobImmune: FIRE ELECTRIC POISON PUMMEL KICK PUNCH DRAIN DISEMBOWEL DISINTEGRATE BACKSTAB AMBUSH ASSAULT

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls I, by Liner
mobShortDesc: Tajte, emissary of sufferance, writhes in relished agony as her gaze falls upon you.
mobLongDesc: A silent, human-like form regards you with disdain as you invade the recesses of her domain.  She is the epitome of mortal fear, mother of nightmares, squalid mistress of broken dreams.  She torments and breaks the stolen souls which reside here.  Her glistening hair whips back from a furrowed brow as she impales you with her horrible gaze.
mobImmune: FIRE ELECTRIC POISON PUMMEL KICK PUNCH DRAIN DISEMBOWEL DISINTEGRATE BACKSTAB AMBUSH ASSAULT

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls I, by Liner
mobShortDesc: A blubbering, mewling form envelops you in a cloud of vapor.
mobLongDesc: A flowing robe parts slowly within the darkness to reveal a ghastly figure within.  Tendrils of sulfurous smoke drift elegantly from tiny pores within its dull, red skin.  Blotches of black, open oozing sores, and tiny red welts pucker and shift over its chest and face as it regards you with tremendous anger.  A cloud of vapor erupts around you as it raises its arms to cast a spell.
affectedByFlags: DETECT-ALIGNMENT DETECT-INVISIBLE SENSE-LIFE SANCTUARY INFRAVISION DODGE

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls I, by Liner
mobShortDesc: A squat man with a scraggly beard bends forward to greet you.
mobLongDesc: A well-built man stands wrapped in huge, flowing furs.  His hair is shaggy and unkempt, his face cracked and worn by years of harsh cold and dangerous excursions.  He regards you with mild curiosity then warm greeting as he sees the toils and mark of the adventurer in your eyes.  He extends a hand and offers a portion of his latest kill, bidding you to stay a while.

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls I, by Liner
mobShortDesc: A drooling imp cavorts among the dim recesses of the caverns.
mobLongDesc: A squat, impish creature scurries along the cavern floor here, gibbering and cackling to itself.  Its luminescent green eyes flash to burning orange as it approaches.  A tiny, dark shroud engulfs its body and matching boots patter along the bare rock. It appears to be a lower minion of the revenant forms, perhaps merely an apprentice.

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls I, by Liner
mobShortDesc: One of the fort's few inhabitants tends her crop in the harsh cold.
mobLongDesc: This weary woman picks incessantly at the dead ground here, trying to coax forth plants for her family's barren table.  Her eyes are gray and solemn, and a single tear tumbles over the landscape of her face as she realizes the futility of her effort.

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls I, by Liner
mobShortDesc: An ancient man lay snoring away in the corner beneath a pile of furs.
mobLongDesc: An ancient man slumbers soundly here on a worn cot.  His brow is wide and shows evidence of the extent of his years.  Flowing white wisps of hair peek out from beneath a hide cap, and his eyelids roll as his snores echo within the shelter.

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls I, by Liner
mobShortDesc: A young boy sits impatiently here, barely glancing in your direction.
mobLongDesc: A young boy sits quietly beneath a shaggy mop of red curls.  A gentle grin touches his lips as he gestures for you to be quiet and turns his rapt attention back to the sleeping form of his grandfather.  He brandishes a tiny feather with which he tickles the old man's nose.

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls I, by Liner
mobShortDesc: A boy wrapped in a bundle of fur screams happily as he makes a snowball.
mobLongDesc: A young boy dances happily along the snowdrift path, oblivious to you and impervious to the cutting cold.  His face is red and full of life, full of youth; his eyes are wide and glittering with the purity and joy only children can experience.

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls I, by Liner
mobShortDesc: A young girl rolls playfully in the snowbanks, smiling at the sky.
mobLongDesc: A young girl frolics in the soft plumes of snow, oblivious to you and impervious to the cutting cold.  Her face is red and full of life, full of youth; her eyes are wide and glittering with the purity and joy only children can experience.

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls I, by Liner
mobShortDesc: A jolly figure towers over the stacks of baubles, offering a good deal.
mobLongDesc: A hardened mountain of a man stands towering over you.  His arms extend to assault you with a double-handshake greeting and his eyes sparkle with the warmth of friendship and the prospect of another sale.  His mouth begins running speedily with the voice of a skilled entrepreneur, but his eyes never leave your own as he displays his wares.

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls I, by Liner
mobShortDesc: A weary man sits quietly behind his table, waiting to take your money.
mobLongDesc: A thin figure sits quietly here, staring at you with mild interest.  His winter attire is almost tailored, a fur-lined coat and hat made from choice furs and not the ragged scraps most inhabitants are forced to purchase.  He rolls a gold coin steadily across his deft fingers, waiting for you to either purchase a pass or leave.

zoneName: Cavern of Lost Souls I, by Liner
mobShortDesc: A sturdy captain barks incoherent orders as he pilots the giant barge.
mobLongDesc: A lumbering beast of a man stands at the prow of the barge. His legs, like the trunks of a tree, are firmly planted on either side of the center, perfectly balanced.  His left eye is covered by a sinister patch, and a ragged bandanna circles his neck.  Scars stand out like thunderbolts on his great powerful arms as he steers the craft along.

mobShortDesc: A white pawn is standing here.
mobLongDesc: A protector of its own colour, also a very brave solider, one that never flee and walk away from away battle. It is waiting to be promoted to be a more important piece in its class.

mobShortDesc: A white queen's castle is standing here.
mobLongDesc: A creature which looks like a building against attack. There are two arms and two legs attached to this particular piece. Its job is to protect the Queen.

mobShortDesc: A white queen's knight is standing here.
mobLongDesc: The most powerful soldier of the white chess, it is responsible to the Queen's safety. It has a head of a horse and a body of mankind, it might be a relative of the centaur family.

mobShortDesc: A white queen's bishop is standing here.
mobLongDesc: A happy bishop who can do everything in an incredibly quick motion.

mobShortDesc: The white queen is standing here
mobLongDesc: She is the most respected and powerful figure in the white chess. She is bad-tempered and gets mad easily, watch out!

mobShortDesc: The white king is standing here.
mobLongDesc: Unlike most kings, he does not enjoy the feeling of being powerful. He gave all his power to the queen, yet he is still a very tough fighter.

mobShortDesc: Santa Clause stands here, calm smile filling the room with warmth.
mobLongDesc: Massive tummy jiggling and shaking, Santa fills his red coat to the bursting point. Small red stains ruin the perfect white of the cuffs and lining, the only evidence of the massive battle raging outside.

mobShortDesc: An elf toy maker stands here, eyes rolling wildly, foam dripping from his mouth.
mobLongDesc: Thick calouses cover his hands from gripping tools day after day making toys. A slight whiff of something stronger then rum comes from his breath, as little globs of spittle fly from his mouth.
mobImmune: FIRE POISON KICK SLEEP CHARM BLINDNESS DRAIN DISEMBOWEL DISINTEGRATE CLAIR SUMMON BLUDGEON BACKSTAB

mobShortDesc: An elf worker stands here, completely encased in armor made from wrapping paper.
mobLongDesc: Tiny papercuts line his face and hands from long hours wrapping presents. Red spittle drips from his lips onto the paper armor he wears, causing it to buckle and warp.
mobImmune: POISON PUMMEL PUNCH SLEEP CHARM BLINDNESS PARALYSIS DRAIN DISINTEGRATE AMBUSH

mobShortDesc: A reindeer paws the ground, an elf impaled and wriggling on his antlers.
mobLongDesc: Blood drips down his antlers, thick fur matted and clotted, his eyes rolling wildly in his head. Hot breath creates clouds of moisture in the air, sharpened teeth showing between his lips. Pawing the ground he looks to be trying to impale something on his remaining antler.
mobImmune: FIRE ELECTRIC POISON PUMMEL SLEEP CHARM BLINDNESS PARALYSIS DISINTEGRATE CLAIR SUMMON BACKSTAB ASSAULT

mobShortDesc: A gaily wrapped present sits here, one corner leaking small amounts of fluid.
mobLongDesc: Looking inside the present reveals a horrifying swirl of elf bones, meat and fecal matter. One eye floats up amidst the mess, staring upwards wildly. The stench rising from within makes you want to scream!
mobImmune: FIRE ELECTRIC POISON PUMMEL SLEEP CHARM BLINDNESS PARALYSIS DRAIN DISEMBOWEL DISINTEGRATE CLAIR SUMMON BACKSTAB AMBUSH ASSAULT

mobShortDesc: An elf crouches here, clad in black latex and sunglasses, he is ready to fight.
mobLongDesc: Hands at the ready, this elf is Santa's personal bodyguard. Ready and able to fight, he assumes everything and everyone is a threat to the big man's time table.
mobImmune: FIRE ELECTRIC KICK SLEEP CHARM BLINDNESS PARALYSIS DRAIN DISINTEGRATE SUMMON STING ASSAULT

mobShortDesc: A towering figure of ice and light watches in silence.
mobLongDesc: A towering construct of ice and crystal stands vigil here, its massive form carved from layered frost and pale-blue stone. Veins of cold light glow faintly beneath its translucent surface, pulsing slowly like a frozen heartbeat. Embedded within its chest is a fractured lantern crystal, radiating a steady frostlight that spills across the floor in long, shimmering rays.
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST

mobShortDesc: A massive pine creature lumbers here, draped in frost and tinsel.
mobLongDesc: This massive sentinel resembles a living pine tree sculpted from frozen wood and ancient bark. Its limbs are thick, knotted branches rimed with ice, and its body is wrapped in layers of evergreen needles hardened by frost. Amber sap glistens beneath cracks in its bark, frozen mid-drip like captured tears.
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST

mobShortDesc: A snowman shudders, its coal eyes burning blue.
mobLongDesc: This unsettling construct resembles a crude humanoid figure formed from packed snow, ice, and broken decorations. Its body is misshapen, as though hastily assembled, with mismatched limbs and a lopsided stance. Frozen ribbons, cracked ornaments, and shards of glass are embedded throughout its form, glinting dully in the cold light.
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST

mobShortDesc: A large, gift-wrapped box sits here, topped with a golden bow.
mobLongDesc: At first glance, this appears to be an oversized gift box left carelessly behind  wrapped in festive paper and tied with a wide, shimmering ribbon. Frost clings to its edges, and the paper crackles softly in the cold air.

mobShortDesc: A translucent mage wrapped in ice-blue rags hovers silently.
mobLongDesc: A translucent figure drifts silently through the air, its form blurred and distorted as though viewed through thick ice. This is the lingering shade of a cryomancer, its robes frozen into flowing arcs that trail behind it like spectral frost. Pale runes shimmer faintly across its body, pulsing with cold magic long after death.
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST

mobShortDesc: The faint shape of a toymaker hums a long-forgotten carol.
mobLongDesc: This weary figure slumps forward slightly, dressed in a thick, threadbare apron dusted with frost and flecks of dried paint. His hands are scarred and stiff from years of crafting, fingers twitching as though still shaping toys in his sleep. Glassy eyes stare unfocused into the distance, caught somewhere between memory and dream.

mobShortDesc: A flickering figure of ember and flame dances restlessly.
mobLongDesc: A warm glow flickers gently in the air, forming the hazy outline of a humanoid figure made of embers and soft golden light. This is a Hearthfire Spirit, its form constantly shifting like flames in a sheltered fireplace. Sparks drift lazily from its body, fading before they touch the ground.
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST

mobShortDesc: A shimmering spirit shaped from pure holiday wishes.
mobLongDesc: Soft golden light gathers into the shape of a tall, graceful figure with ribbon like trails streaming from its arms. Its face is featureless but warm, as though brimming with kindness. Wisps of wrapping paper swirl around its form, each fluttering scrap whispering a different childs wish. When it moves, the air is filled with the scent of pine and freshly opened gifts.

mobShortDesc: A towering construct made entirely of wrapped boxes and packing tape.
mobLongDesc: Standing nearly eight feet tall, this lumbering figure is built from stacked parcels of every size. Its joints are reinforced with layers of glossy packing tape, and colorful tags dangle from its broad shoulders. When it walks, its body creaks like thick cardboard under strain. A massive bow rests atop its head like a crown.

mobShortDesc: A floating star spirit shedding gentle celestial radiance.
mobLongDesc: This being appears as a radiant star suspended in the air, its light shifting through hues of silver and blue. Trails of stardust drift behind it as it moves, illuminating every shadow it touches. Though silent, its presence brings a calm, steady warmth.

mobShortDesc: A jingle-bell-wearing trickster bursting with holiday cheer.
mobLongDesc: Clad in a motley outfit of bright red, green, and gold, the Jester tumbles into view with a chorus of jingles. His long cap bobs with every exaggerated step, and his painted smile glows with magical mischief. He carries an oversized candy cane like a staff and leaves tiny bursts of confetti with every movement.

mobShortDesc: A magical postmaster spirit wearing a coat of enchanted frostmail.
mobLongDesc: The Courier appears as a tall, dignified figure with a long winter coat woven from shimmering ice blue mail. A leather satchel glowing with soft red runes hangs at his side, and snowflakes swirl in a constant halo around him. His eyes shine like twin lanterns, calm and eternal. Every step he takes echoes with sleigh bell chimes.

mobShortDesc: A burly magical porter carrying Santas enchanted shipment crates.
mobLongDesc: This stout, muscular figure resembles a titan sized worker from Santas workshop. Dressed in heavy fur-lined work gear and carrying massive wooden crates on his back, the Porter stomps forward with booming steps that shake the ground. His beard is braided with bits of holly, and his boots glow faintly with runes of endurance.

mobShortDesc: A ghostly figure clad in endlessly swirling ribbons.
mobLongDesc: The Wraith drifts silently, its translucent form wrapped in shimmering ribbons and bright patterned paper that flutter with supernatural energy. Its eyes glow with emerald fire beneath a hood of folded gift wrap. When agitated, it unravels strands of ribbon like whips, each decorated with snowflakes, bows, and tiny jingling bells.

mobShortDesc: A kindly old gnome bundled in patchwork winter gear waits here
mobLongDesc: A blank of primal clay, waiting to be shaped.

mobShortDesc: A jingle-bell-wearing trickster bursting with holiday cheer.
mobLongDesc: A blank of primal clay, waiting to be shaped.

mobShortDesc: An inhabitant is in his own house and sleeps like a pig here.
mobLongDesc: He is the commoner of the city of Cornelius, leave him alone because he is in a bad mood.

mobShortDesc: A polar bear is here looking for something to eat.
mobLongDesc: A white giant bear which usually lives in North Pole. It looks very angry.

mobShortDesc: A Cornelius Guard is here protecting the City.
mobLongDesc: A very tough guard who is here to protect his city.

mobShortDesc: A drunk is here sleeping like a pig.
mobLongDesc: A drunken and dissolve man.

mobShortDesc: The Food ShopKeeper is here frying a polar bear.
mobLongDesc: This man has a very greedy face.

mobShortDesc: A clever wizard is here making potions.
mobLongDesc: He is a very clever person and he can make some very powerful magic items.

mobShortDesc: A larvae is here, squirming on the floor.
mobLongDesc: These larvae are anywhere from 1 to 4 feet long, in varying stages of development.  All have at least vaguely humanoid looking heads that are grossly misshapen.

mobShortDesc: A diseased, skeletal figure stalks his lord's enemies.
mobLongDesc: Emaciated and putrefying, Nergal's bodyguards are hideous to behold. Even more hideous is the fact that they blend with the night and move with a mystic silent grace.

mobShortDesc: Erishkigal, mistress of death, lays here contemplating you.
mobLongDesc: A beautiful shapely woman with dark hair and very pale skin.  The way her coal black eyes burn deep into your soul gives you the chills.
actionFlags: SPEC SENTINEL ISNPC AGGRESSIVE STAY-ZONE ARM

mobShortDesc: Nergal, Lord of corruption stands here, oozing.
mobLongDesc: His stomach protrudes, bloated and white.  Open sores and pustules burst upon his skin, even as you look at him.  One touch of his skin is sure to bring about endless agony.

mobShortDesc: Charlie, a rushing dove sits on the guitar.
mobLongDesc: Charlie is a redeyed dove grinding its teeth tuning Doobie's guitar. As you look at him, he offers you a big fat reefer.

mobShortDesc: [1] A large marble gargoyle statue is perched atop a glistening fountain here.
mobLongDesc: You see an enormous animated marble gargoyle, its massive arms ending in extremely sharp claws that could easily rend the finest armor in the land. Its eyes shine with an unearthly glow and it makes absolutely no sound when it moves.
actionFlags: SENTINEL ISNPC STAY-ZONE MEMORY FLY SHIELD
mobImmune: FIRE ELECTRIC POISON PUMMEL KICK PUNCH SLEEP CHARM PARALYSIS DRAIN DISEMBOWEL DISINTEGRATE

mobShortDesc: The Master at Arms is here, diligently guarding the Armory's stores.
mobLongDesc: Standing in front of the door to the clan's vault is a behemoth of a man standing easily three heads taller then you and wearing on his hip an enormous two-handed sword which it looks like he would wield as deftly as a dagger given his extraordinary size. He nods at you slightly and stands aside, recognizing you as one of the people he's not supposed to kill.
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST PUNCH

mobShortDesc: Gruumsh, the bartender floats near the bar looking for just the right drink.
mobLongDesc: You see a rather rotund beholder, a doubly unusual sight in that beholders are supposed to hate humans with a passion. Word has it that many years ago, Gruumsh was rescued from a magical trap set by an archmage seeking to unlock the secrets of the magic of beholder eyes by the ancestral founders of the clan, and has remained unwaveringly loyal to it ever since.

mobShortDesc: A man stands here, head hidden behind his black hood.
mobLongDesc: Within the shadows on the room, this man stands there, head hidden behind his black hood.  He senses your presence and knows of your desires. Lifting his arms, he motions those in need of rest and holds back those who are not.  He is known only as the hooded man, a receptionist that guards the flaming gateway to Diabolik Sanctuary.  Though he may seem frail, he is not helpless.  He will destroy any one person, who does not belong or tries to force themselves into the gate.

mobShortDesc: A chained up man is here, whimpering in fear.
mobLongDesc: Chained and shackled by the ankles, this helpless soul whimpers backwards at your approach.  Judging from his torn armor and other equipment accessories, he used to be a frequent mudder that has made a wrong turn for the worst.  Evidently, he was purged for crimes committed on this plane, and has to spend his entire existence as a Diabolik training dummy. He talks frequently to himself, and screams horrifically when recounting the incidents up to and upon his day of judgement -- over and over again.

mobShortDesc: Ugly is casually lounging about here, looking quite ... beautiful, in fact.
mobLongDesc: Whoever named this drop-dead gorgeous demon had a strange sense of humor - Ugly has to be one of the most delectable creatures known to all womanhood! His firm body and soft, bedroom eyes can make any female jump through the gates of hell!  There probably have already been a few...

mobShortDesc: A lovely demoness waits here, offering her "services" to all.
mobLongDesc: This lovely demoness is the perfect realization of all of those dreams you wouldn't dream of telling to your mother.  From the looks of the way she's coyly smiling at you, it seems as if she can read your mind like an open book...  She doesn't look as if she minds in the slightest, the vixen...

mobShortDesc: Tantalus stands in a pool of dirty water, looking extremely bored.
mobLongDesc: Though his robes appear to be somewhat bedraggled and worn, they appear to be more like an old, favorite bathrobe than tattered rags.  Equally, though Tantalus appears a bit slimmer than most men of his age, he's not exactly a starving soul who hasn't had a bite to eat in eons...  His present job is to store items away in the vaults of these caverns, which are cleverly hidden by the long, wavering shadows cast by the flickering torches.  It doesn't seem too bad a profession -- locking valuables up and wetting your feet once in a while...

mobShortDesc: Lilith grins evilly, serving up grails of blood and paladin steaks.
mobLongDesc: A succulent vixen, this demon princess openly flaunts her well-formed body, taking great pleasure in the reactions she elicits from every male who just _happens_ to glance her way.  Lilith takes especial pleasure in teasing the normally chaste and upright paladins who futilely try to resist their darker, bestial animal passions.  She winks at you, offering a rusty fork...

mobShortDesc: A thin, gaunt figure twitches uncontrollably, his paladin garb in tatters.
mobLongDesc: Once an aspiring and hopeful paladin, this snivelling beast is no more than a pathetic ensemble of feces, dirty rags, and endless tears.  It took less than a full hour to reduce this shining example of the paladin class to a quivering, self-defecating slug...  Perhaps it would be merciful to put him out of his misery...  then again, it is quite amusing watching him just _twitch_ every now and then.

mobShortDesc: A small pixie hovers about, busying herself in the garden.
mobLongDesc: One of the Little Folk, this exuberant pixie works in happy service for the denizens of this fine hall. Her wage is paid in pizza, and her brethren look upon her status with awe. A faint green aura surrounds her foot-tall form and on her back is a pair of wings much like those of a dragonfly.

mobShortDesc: A giant tree-like creature, clad in green and gray bark, stands here.
mobLongDesc: Rumours abound that the Entwives were wiped out, but the creature before you stands as contrarian proof. She has enormous trunk-like legs, ending in seven toes, all covered in the same bark coloured skin as her trunk... torso... whatever. Despite the eradication of much of her kin she seems in relatively good spirits, aware of the ebb and flow of life. A loud creaking accompanies her cracking a smile and she welcomes you into the grand hall with grandmotherly warmth and kindness.
mobImmune: FIRE ELECTRIC POISON PUMMEL KICK PUNCH SLEEP CHARM BLINDNESS PARALYSIS DRAIN DISEMBOWEL DISINTEGRATE SUMMON HIT BLUDGEON PIERCE SLASH WHIP CLAW BITE STING CRUSH HACK CHOP SLICE BACKSTAB AMBUSH ASSAULT
mobImmune2Flags: COLD SOUND CHEMICAL ACID FEAR BASH

mobShortDesc: A pleasant looking tree nymph hums softly to herself as she prances about.
mobLongDesc: Fair skinned and lithe, this oak tree nymph bears a pleasant beauty akin to that of the sun cresting over a hillside as it bathes a lush emerald vale in its morning light. A creature of the forest if there ever was, Echo bears a mischievous smile as she slowly, gracefully floats throughout the glade. Her features are that of the forest: bundles of hair striking strong association to the thin branches of a tree, skin occasionally textured with that of an oak's crinkled bark and dressed, if the word could be applied, in a thin veil of moss and leaves, covering just enough to peak curiosity.
mobImmune: FIRE ELECTRIC POISON PUMMEL KICK PUNCH SLEEP CHARM BLINDNESS PARALYSIS DRAIN DISEMBOWEL DISINTEGRATE SUMMON HIT BLUDGEON PIERCE SLASH WHIP CLAW BITE STING CRUSH HACK CHOP SLICE BACKSTAB AMBUSH ASSAULT

mobShortDesc: Greedle the Witch is here stirring a strange mixture.
mobLongDesc: You see an very old woman slowly stirring a huge spoon into her black cauldron. She has long white hair draping down her back and partially covering her face.  This is Greedle, the witch.  Greedle was once a wandering gypsy until she found the Dark Legion, where she retired her nomadic roots and became a practitioner of more dark spells.  Using her ancient knowledge as a gypsy and the power of the Legion, Greedle has become one of the most powerful people in the Legion.  Though, her century old age keeps her from fighting, she still proves herself useful in many ways.

mobShortDesc: Holo the Demon-Protector swoops above your head here.
mobLongDesc: Before you stands a tremendous demon.  His eyes blaze the colour of scarlet, they watch you intsenly from above as he swoops just about your head.  His flesh is black and red, and his huge wings stretch out from his back in a large span.  He has a very muscular build and his claws and fangs are incredibly sharp and long.  He has two huge horns jutting from his head, they glow with magical power. Holo, the Dark Demon is a gift from the Gods of Dark Legion. The gods gave Holo to the Legion for extra protection against anyone, or thing that may dared challenge the Legion. For centuries Holo has served, sacrificing the blood of many for his creators and for his clan.

mobShortDesc: Veim is here guarding the private chambers.
mobLongDesc: You see a rather young man wielding a curved sabre standing before you.  Though he doesn't look all that harmless, he is actually one of the greatest fighters the Legion has ever seen. Like Greedle, Veim is one of the oldest surviving members of the Legion.  Though Veim appears to be young he is actually very ancient, his dark magic transforms him.  Veim is now incapable of continuing his fighting career, so he has decided to aid the Legion by taking care of the castle.  He says he will stay until the Legion dominates the world, then he will pass his time and enter his long awaited peace.

mobShortDesc: Raven is here protecting the Dark Legion vaults.
mobLongDesc: You gaze into the eyes of the most viscious warrior the Legion has ever come across.  Raven the Tempest has served the Legion faithfully for decades, though her cruel, and torturous ways were not always smiled upon.  Raven has been known for toying with her victims.  She has a flair for fighting, and enjoys every second she gets to make her enemy suffer.  Her ways were so cruel and evil that the Legion had to keep her in the castle, where she was not such a threat.  She was then only used when it was very neccesary that the Legion needed a strong fighter.  Now, she is in charge of making sure the castle vaults are safe and in order.  She also gets a chance at the Catherine Wheel, when a punishment is due to an enemy.  Be careful what you do to her, or you may be her next victim.

mobShortDesc: Grunthor the Vigilant stands before you barring the way.
mobLongDesc: Barring your way into the inner halls of the Newbitorium stands the immense figure of Grunthor the Vigilant. Captured as a young boy in the Bolg lands far South of the Maelstrom, Grunthor has grown to be over 7 feet tall. With the width of 3 men, Grunthor could crush you with a single look of his metallic blue eyes.
affectedByFlags: DETECT-INVISIBLE SENSE-LIFE SANCTUARY SPHERE INFRAVISION FLY INVUL FURY
mobImmune: FIRE ELECTRIC POISON PARALYSIS DISINTEGRATE SUMMON

mobShortDesc: Achmed the Vault Guard is standing here.
mobLongDesc: At the edge of your vision you see a diminutive figure, robed in black silk, standing in the corner. Shadows cast by the flickering torches seem to wrap around Achmed the Vault Guard and cloak him in darkness. You can feel the subtle waves of violence that roll over you when Achmed returns your look.
affectedByFlags: DETECT-INVISIBLE DETECT-MAGIC SENSE-LIFE SANCTUARY SPHERE INFRAVISION DODGE INVUL

mobShortDesc: The grand marble statue of the Saber-Tooth Tiger stands guard here.
mobLongDesc: A grand marble Saber-Toothed Tiger, who was famed to have saved this quaint town, stands guard here.

mobShortDesc: An aging wizard stands here, slowly stirring his cauldron.
mobLongDesc: An aging wizard stands before you, slowly stirring his potion mixture in the large stone cauldron.  The wizard is dressed in a long blue robe laiden with sparkling gems depicting a starry night sky. You wonder, could this be the traveling mage who created the Saber-Tooth Tiger that protects this town?

mobShortDesc: Azura the Amazon vault guard is standing here.
mobLongDesc: The guard stands what looks to you to be at least 10 feet tall. Shadows of the passing day flicker and move across his unblinking face. Could anything get past this guy?

mobShortDesc: A jolly innkeeper stands here, waiting to cater to your every need.
mobLongDesc: A plump innkeeper stands before you with a big smile, listening to your every problem and hoping for the next drink order and a big tip!  How about another round of ale for everyone?!?

mobShortDesc: A little black cat is standing here, waiting to serve her mistress.
mobLongDesc: You notice the small black cat slink in and out of the shadows of the room silently as if she weren't a real part of this world.

mobShortDesc: Deyshall the Chief Instructor stands here with an air of deadly competence.
mobLongDesc: He is a noble looking man in his late thirties who has been using a sword since before he could walk.
affectedByFlags: DETECT-ALIGNMENT DETECT-INVISIBLE SENSE-LIFE SANCTUARY SPHERE INFRAVISION DODGE INVUL

mobShortDesc: Sharak grins widely as he sees you approach, seems he gets few visitors.
mobLongDesc: Sharak is a stocky dwarf haliling from the strong and proud peoples of the Helventia Mountains.  Unusually friendly for a dwarf he greets you with a jovial wink and strong nudge in the side.  You can tell that he takes great pride in his wears and this shop of his.

mobShortDesc: Joseph the Giant Grizzly Panda is squatting here eating some leaves.
mobLongDesc: A Giant Grizzly Panda is squatting here.

mobShortDesc: A maiden stands here, her unicorn steed by her side.
mobLongDesc: This beautiful maiden has long flowing blonde hair, cascading down around her shoulders.  She wears a dress of cloud white, symbolizing the purity that has allowed her to tame such a noble beast.  She smiles at you as you approach, and gestures to show she has rooms you may rest in.

mobKeywords: unicorn vault guard creature equus horse white
mobShortDesc: A creature of untainted white, with a glorious spiraling horn stands here, guarding something.
mobLongDesc: The most noble Equus, this magnificent stallion stands with head held high, his wispy beard fluttering in the wind.  From his head protrudes a horn of unspeakable beauty, radiating with power and sensual energy.  His muscles ripple beneath his shimmering coat, and you cannot help but feel a bit in awe by the sheer majesty of this creature.

mobShortDesc: A beautiful narwhal floats in mid-air here, tidying her wares.
mobLongDesc: This medium-sized toothed whale seems quite content to be floating in the middle of the air, rather than in her natural Arctic environment.  Her lush silver skin reflects the light that drifts in from overhead, while her horn glimmers with a luminance of its own.  She appears to be restocking shelves with various wares that adventurers depend upon.

mobShortDesc: A Massive Bearicorn is here, ready to train you in the ways of war.
mobLongDesc: A Massive Bearicorn is here, ready to train you in the ways of war. This enormous snow-white creature stands nearly ten feet in length, with a massive four-foot spiraling horn protruding from its head.  It looks at you with an appraising eye, as though wondering what you could possibly want of it. Then it opens its massive jaw to let out a stretching yawn, revealing row upon row of incisors, before curling up and settling down for a nap.

mobShortDesc: Faelwen the treasurer is here, sorting out recent acquisitions...
mobLongDesc: A petite woodelf maiden stand before you, her hair brown and braided.  She is wearing a pair of round silver-rimmed glasses on her little nose, a silvery silk blouse, and a tight, green wool skirt.

mobShortDesc: Durion the self-medicating chemist is here, tasting his own brew...
mobLongDesc: Wearing a silvery grey silken lab-coat and thick black horn-rimmed glasses, this tall skinny figure of an elf looks down on you with a grin on his face.  Looking into his big black dilated pupils you can clearly see that this man is under the influence of heavy drugs and is in no way suited to medicate, let alone operate on anyone! Is that blood on his hands? Where are his gloves??

mobShortDesc: The chillest dude ever sits quietly at the counter, sipping from a small cup.
mobLongDesc: Resplendent in fresh flannel pajama bottoms and a chunky sweater, a middle-aged man sits here, pondering the vastness of exsitence. His wisdom, certainly beyond his years, attracts you to interrupt his excogiation and ask for guidance, or more certainly a task to bring enlightenment.

mobShortDesc: A man with an impressive red mullet is practicing intently here.
mobLongDesc: A somewhat terrifying, but strangely friendly figure stands here. His hair is cropped short at the top, but falls into a long tail at the back. He seems to be pre-occupied with performing what appear to be "martial arts" moves, but upon seeing you, prepares himself for training...

mobShortDesc: A Lifelike Crystalline Statue of a warrior stands here.
mobLongDesc: A large statue of a well-muscled warrior, seemingly waiting patiently for the next call to arms.

mobShortDesc: A huge white and black cat is crouched and snarling here!
mobLongDesc: Phasteus, Marcus' familiar and mount, is here. Fully 6' high at the shoulder... not a beast to meet when he is hungry.... Speaking of which...

mobShortDesc: A ghostly figure is here cleaning up the room.
mobLongDesc: A transparent figure is here tidying up the room.

mobShortDesc: A huge reddish creature with large bat wings is standing here!
mobLongDesc: The sight is simply awesome. A huge red creature with the face of a canine and large bat wings is here. Fully 9 feet tall and at least 2000 lbs, he is probably the most frightening creature you have ever met.
affectedByFlags: DETECT-INVISIBLE SENSE-LIFE SANCTUARY SPHERE DODGE DUAL

mobShortDesc: A man in dark robes is standing here.
mobLongDesc: A relatively young man, Marcus is just beginning to show the signs of age. Looking to be in his mid-thirties, it is hard to believe the stories that he is actually centuries old.
mobImmune: FIRE ELECTRIC POISON SLEEP CHARM BLINDNESS PARALYSIS DRAIN

mobShortDesc: A large, menacing, scaled warrior stands here, ready to defend his master.
mobLongDesc: This Guard stands at least a foot taller than the largest one seen patrolling the grounds. Another species, perhaps?  Whatever the case may be, judging from sheer size and build alone, this one looks much tougher than the ones outside.

mobKeywords: highlord kiri torin dragon high lord
mobShortDesc: The master of the Fortress stands here, planning his next conquest.
mobLongDesc: As your gazes meet, you remember the statues in front of the Fortress... It is your last conscious thought.
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST

mobShortDesc: A beautiful golden haired elf maiden is chained here.
mobLongDesc: This beautiful maiden has seen happier times. Some of the scars on her back seem only freshly healed. She looks at you with longing eyes and states that she will do ANYTHING to be free of this cruel place.

mobShortDesc: A burly dwarf stands here chained to a stake.
mobLongDesc: The many scars crossing this dwarf's back have daunted his spirit none at all. He looks at you with sheer hatred and you are certain that, given a chance, he'd kill you.

mobShortDesc: A scaly green soldier of the high lord's armies is patrolling the grounds.
mobLongDesc: This Large muscular lizard looks to be the cross between a monitor and a gnoll. It stands about 7 feet tall and has a massive tail dragging the ground behind it.

mobShortDesc: A troll is here making "foot soup"... he's adding the feet right now.
mobLongDesc: You see a large troll with a pained look on his face. As you look down, you notice a long jagged gash in his finger.

mobShortDesc: A large, reddish-scaled lizard is roaming the volcano.
mobLongDesc: While this lizard looks big to you, you realize that it is just a baby. You also realize that if this is a baby, you might not want to meet the parent.

mobShortDesc: A huge, red dragon is here, licking his lips hungrily.
mobLongDesc: You have heard legends of this beast!! Pyrak the Red! The deadliest dragon that ever existed upon this world. Intelligent and cunning, he is considered to be the greatest menace to ever terrorize the innocent farmers and herders of the world. He is a scourge, but a scourge that you can rid the world of. That is, if you are strong enough.

mobLongDesc: A relatively young man, Marcus is just beginning to show the signs of age. Looking to be in his mid-thirties, it is hard to believe the stories that he is actually centuries old.

mobLongDesc: A lizard warrior who seems to be making maps of the region for his master.

mobShortDesc: A greasy Italian plumber bends over in front of you here.
mobLongDesc: A huge handlebar moustache hides most of this italian plumber's features, thank god.

mobShortDesc: The urinal fairy flutters around you head, emiting a strong and familiar odor.
mobLongDesc: She drops you a little wink as she flies around rapidly.

mobShortDesc: A riding horse shakes its mane here.
mobLongDesc: This tall, slender horse is a light chestnut in color, with a white stripe down its forehead. It prances and capers about as it considers the idea of galloping through wonderful forests and plains, whinnying in horsey delight, its shaggy mane cascading over its neck.

mobShortDesc: One of the dreaded Sith is slinking here in the shadows.

mobShortDesc: A Ragged Gypsy is standing here, contemplating the situation.
mobLongDesc: An old woman stands here looking worried.  Bags and wrinkles line her face, her eyes deep in thought.  A hood is draped over her head, but you can see the white mane that is her hair.  Gypsies of her age usually the elder leader of her clan and have accumulated many stories over the years.  But gypsies are shunned upon in the civilized world, so they usually do their business of fortune telling away from any large community.  This gypsy paces around in circles looking like she's waiting for someone.

mobShortDesc: The Gatekeeper of Da'Sharr is standing guard here.
mobLongDesc: A tall, imposing guard stands here on his watch, making sure no one gets past the gates.  He glares in your direction as a warning to keep your distance or else he'll shred you to pieces.

mobShortDesc: A spectral figure of a guard is here, roaming the halls.
mobLongDesc: This ghastly, disformed figure of a guard floats around here serving his master, the warden of this facility obediently.  He was once flesh and blood, but dark powers of this domain corrupted this innocent soul.  He now searches in hate for other living beings in the quest to kill those he used to walk among -- as his eternal torment.

mobShortDesc: Milhouse the star roach of "Special Entrie Platter made in Heaven" (TM)
mobLongDesc: Milhouse the star roach of "Special Entrie Platter made in Heaven" (TM) is here and giving you an earful -- He just wont stop talking!  Standing on his hind legs, Milhouse looks to be 5 inches high off the ground. Scrawny-looking and pathetic, this cockroach doesn't seem like much of a threat.

mobShortDesc: Rizzo the Prison Cook stands here stirring endlessly.
mobLongDesc: This is Rizzo--Da'Sharr's official cook extraordinaire. Unfortunately, he don't cook to well, or at least not so good.  Da'Sharr couldn't afford a real cook so they hired an illegal immigrant REAL CHEAP.  He works for below minimum and enjoys what he does... which is illuminating the overpopulation in the cells. Ever since he took over, there has been more room than ever for newer inmates! Which is good for the tax payers, but one things for sure.. You're not going to catch the warden or the mayor eating this slop.
actionFlags: SENTINEL SCAVENGER ISNPC STAY-ZONE MEMORY ARM

mobShortDesc: A Hairy-looking Roach crawls around here, searching for its dinner.
mobLongDesc: A 3x3 inch roach crawls around here, looking VERY HUNGRY.  It usually eats trash and whatever it finds lying around, but this cockroach looks viciously hungry and could go for human flesh right about now.

mobShortDesc: The intimate inmate stands here, eyeing you with drooling interest.
mobLongDesc: Buck naked and extremely wet, Benjamin winks in your direction hinting at something. You shudder at the thought, and try to ignore his insinuating presence. Out of no where, Ben screams in frantic horror, (or pleasure) ..he had just dropped his only bar of soap. Why don't you be a nice guy and help him out?  *wink* *wink*

mobShortDesc: An Elite Guard towers over you is standing here.
mobLongDesc: He wears a fur coat and looks like a walking tank.  Mostly known for their enthusiasm for punishing prisoners, they enjoy their line of work. In fact they encourage them to escape!  Thus, prompting them into action. Keep in mind that once they start, you better say your prayers -- when they're done, you'd be nothing more than a slab of steak on the pavement.

mobShortDesc: A shackled man is slumped up against the wall here, in most obvious pain.
mobLongDesc: Blood flows freely from his mouth along with visible traces of dry blood that line uncleansed.  His eyes are swollen shut, and his groans for death rather than to spend another day in this state, saddens you.  Closer examination, reveals puncture marks on his neck, and pale complexion of blood that is drained away from his face.  You are no expert in undead physiology, but it doesn't take a genius to realize that this man has been bitten by a vampire. Intestines dangle from his wide open guts, maggots and vermin feast heartily on them.  He open his eyes wide and looks in the direction of the wooden stake in his hand.  "Only with the powers of the stake, can the warden be defeated!" he screams in agony.  With that last statement, he slumps back unconscious.

mobShortDesc: A Gypsy is shackled in chains here.
mobLongDesc: Shackled in chains, this gypsy winces in pain with every movement.  Blood covers her wrists and looks extremely dehydrated.  Her torn shirt reveals her thin and pale figure, whip marks and older scars make for some erotic pleasure the abductor has experienced.  She looks as if she hasn't been fed in weeks, right to say -- haven't been fed at all.  Obviously, she was left to die and to use her as an example to gain discipline from the gypsy clans bordering Da'Sharr.  Dry tears line her face and her sky blue eyes tell you to end her suffering, rather than continue on in this state.

mobShortDesc: A Thick-maned beast crouches here, snarling at your entrance.
mobLongDesc: Half wolf and half dwarf, this were-beast is a spawn of evil creation.  No-one knows of his origins or history, nor would any one dare to ask -- for he kills everything in his sight, dead and living.  It is said that the warden success- fully dragged him into this place and has been here for centuries.  He vows one day to obtain his revenge, and at nights -- howls can be heard from this cell calling to the heavens.  He stands no more than three feet from head to toe, but don't let his small appearance fool you, he can kill you where you stand...A canine like muzzle supports a wet black snout, can smell a man from miles away.  Round ears lay flat against the beast's broad skull, along with sharp yellow fangs that can rip apart and snap a person in two.  A thick mane grows from the back of his neck, rich and something seemingly lively about it. A very impressive adversary that may be better off left alone...

mobShortDesc: A pair of red eyes and six walking legs, dwells here in the shadows.
mobLongDesc: Clearly out of place, this six legged spider-like dark elf was taken from his safe haven the underdark, and caged here for the enjoyment of the warden. Piercing red eyes and fuming snarl, this drider is not pleased to be locked up here like some zoo animal.  Half Drow and Half Spider, this drider makes for an excellent exhibition.  Driders are usually the punished dark elves put in this state for their unsatisfactory deeds in the eyes of Lloth, God of the underdark -- and forced to spend their remaining years in their arachnid state, roaming the caverns killing everything in sight. Driders are especially a rare find, and the warden wasted no time to acquire this beast.

mobShortDesc: An Animate Skeleton shambles about the room, looking quite pissed.
mobLongDesc: Laughing hysterically, the animate beast's glowing eyes pierces deep into your soul.  You scream in ultimate anguish, as you turn to stone slowly from the feet up. Didn't your mother ever tell you there'd be days like this?
affectedByFlags: SENSE-LIFE SANCTUARY SPHERE INFRAVISION STATUE DUAL FURY

mobShortDesc: A Blind Sage rests here comfortably, waiting to serve his master.
mobLongDesc: Blind, mute and deaf--Voldra serves his master, the warden of Da'Sharr with the utmost obedience.  His milky white eyes glares forward with un-emotion and non-passiveness. One side of his face is burned severely, leaving a deep scar that will forever tarnish his appearance.  Bony, age-spotted hands caresses a crystal ball which glows slightly, illuminating the dark room.  The ancient artifact would reveal nothing to the casual observer, however to the one trained in these mystic arts--the crystal ball has much to say.  Voldra serves the warden, and serves him well.  Gypsy stories say that Voldra and the warden were once very close childhood friends, but a freak accident blinded the sage and made him unattuned to the senses around him.  Since then, the warden felt it in his heart to lock up his "friend", give him water, food and a roof over his head -- In exchange for his services, which he is to serve for the rest of his existence.  Though blind and mute, Voldra communicates through written language, jotting down all of his "for-seeings" on sheets of paper.
affectedByFlags: DETECT-INVISIBLE SENSE-LIFE SANCTUARY SPHERE INFRAVISION INVUL DUAL

mobShortDesc: The Warden of Da'Sharr rests here, anticipating your arrival.
mobLongDesc: You gaze into the eyes of the undead lord and see years of accumulated wisdom and authority.  His troops follow his commands to the letter and his influence on the neighboring town has made him renowned in the lands throughout.  Gypsies call him "Modeuur" in their language for the "dead, but yet living." They serve him unwilling, giving the vampire information in the outside world -- in the exchange for their continual existence.  Not a bad deal, until one day the warden got sloppy and decided to make examples of some of the gypsies as a showing of his hold and power.  It wasn't long until these few gypsies retaliated and casted down their powers to rid themselves of this nemesis. That was five centuries ago, and now he is back and ready to take over where he left off.  Modeuur rests here calmly, grinning broadly as you approach. His skin is pale in color and eyes are of dull grey, staring at you with hypnotic gaze.  Beware of this one, he is seasoned and has years of wisdom behind him.
affectedByFlags: SENSE-LIFE SANCTUARY SPHERE INFRAVISION DODGE INVUL FURY

mobShortDesc: a huge, trained attack dog is sitting here growling at you!
mobLongDesc: This huge scruffy mutt drools from his mouth, snarling at you with distaste. He's a trained attack dog, taught the most vicious and violent ways to kill. He will attack anyone he notices -- and won't stop till that person is shredded ground beef.  His sole obedience is towards his master, the captain of the guard -- who on many occasions, have used prison inmates as feeding grounds for these shabby canines.

mobShortDesc: The Captain of the Guard snarls at you with drunken rage!
mobLongDesc: Bags of line are visible right underneath his eyes.  A tired demeanor is clearly imprinted on his face.  You would be too if you were in command of an army of guards and soldiers.  He doesn't even have time out to spend the money he makes, which is a generous amount -- and you know what money does to a person... The captain has gotten sloppy and reckless in recent times, but overall, he has been doing the same job for over 500 hundred years -- and he does it well.

mobShortDesc: The First Lieutenant paces around here nervously.
mobLongDesc: One of the captain's most trustworthy men, Lieutenant Jobs would die for his commanding officer.  However, in recent weeks, the Lieutenant have questioned some of the captain's orders.  But his loyalty remains rigid and he does everything possible to please his superior.

mobShortDesc: The Ancient Statue of Justice stands tall here, motionless.
mobLongDesc: Gazing into her eyes, you feel at ease knowing your evil deeds have been cleansed and forgiven.  As you turn to stone, Lady Justice gently whispers to you, "Justice is done."

mobLongDesc: A tremendous Ogre scratches his furry head with a scabrous hand as you look at him. He seems very confused and very angry. You can tell this because he grunts, snarls, and attacks you!

mobLongDesc: Huge yellow fangs, green, glowing eyes, and a naked tail. This lovely beast likes both fresh AND rotted meat, so he may save some of you for later.

mobShortDesc: A bloodthirsty mite is waiting to spring on its next victim.
mobLongDesc: This fattened mite has had many hosts for dinner, maybe you are next on his menu. It pauses only a moment before springing at your jugular.

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: A willowy woman stands here screaming, the mist visible behind her.
mobLongDesc: As you look at the Banshee, she turns her shriek directly at you!!!

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: The water bubbles slightly as it feels your presence.
mobLongDesc: The watery muck monster mobilizes its body into a humanoid form to put an end to this infernal intrusion. Large flowing hands reach out to grab and once again absorb the energy of foolish prey.

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: A demonic horse's head rises from the water here, red eyes gleaming.
mobLongDesc: The Pookah is a small horse, almost as small as a pony. However, it is covered by water plants, and it has very sharp teeth and glowing red eyes. You even notice that it has sharp claws on its paws, as it neighs a demonic sound and attacks you with them.

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: A dwarf wearing a blood-red cap stands here, grinning.
mobLongDesc: A short, hunchbacked dwarf stands here, picking his sharp canines with a gleaming knife. He wears a red skullcap, dyed with human blood, and a necklace made of fingerbones.

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: A suit of armor comes to life to guard the museum's treasures.
mobLongDesc: A classic suit of full steel platemail creaks forward from its eternal sleep to stop your thievery of the museum's treasures. A greenish glow radiates from behind the visor of his sturdy helm. The full length tower shield held by the armor has a beautiful crest of a locust etched into it.

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: [1] A massive pile of gold glitters alluringly here.
mobLongDesc: A massive pile of gold lies here, seemingly stuck together somehow...

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: A fearsome were-beast turns his head to look at you, yellow eyes gleaming...
mobLongDesc: Covered in short, sable fur, Tamur stands only slightly hunched over. His eyes gleam a fierce, mad yellow; the pupils narrow stripes of black running vertically. His huge canines jut out from under a large, black, damp nose. His whiskers quiver and a stream of drool dangles from his lower lip. Tamur's sharp claws make no sound as he erotically extends them from the tips of his furred fingers.

mobLongDesc: A large suave man paces around the room, dressed in pretty plain clothing outside of a rich and colorful cloak that descends to the floor.

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: A stumpy troll sits here, peacefully gazing at the small brook.
mobLongDesc: The Domovoi is a short troll, barely as tall as a young lad. Yet he is built very strongly, and his ropy muscles ripple beneath his ragged, dusty clothing. His dull grey hair is tousled and cowlick-ridden, and it has never even heard tales of combs or their like. The Domovoi smiles peacefully as he takes a rest from his life's work of keeping his bridge tidy, and watches the glimmering surface of the small eddy of the brook which chuckles merrily beneath his bridge.

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: A Large Beast with Seven Tentacles
mobLongDesc: A large slimy beast swims around in the sewage as its numerous tentacles roam float freely in the gunk. Its large pink body and curved beak make a disgusting sound as it screeches.

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: A Hungry Looking Swarm of Fish
mobLongDesc: A large group of fish swim together, barring their tiny teeth. Their silvery scales shimmer in the light cast throughout the room.

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: A Vampire stares blankly around the room.
mobLongDesc: The vampire looks dead, its eyes hollow and head hanging low. However, it also just seems to mope around the room, barely looking at anything happening. Its fangs still glean in the light around the room, and it seems to twitch ever so slightly at the smell of fresh blood.

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: A bird with large feathers made of ice.
mobLongDesc: A large blue and green bird stands seven feet into the air. Its large feathers on its back and tail are covered in a thin sheet of blue ice that glows in the blue light in the cavern. Its large black eyes stare at anything that moves in the room.

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: A Shrunken Dragon roars at the room.
mobLongDesc: A black dragon paces around the room, its wings reaching around six feet in length when fully spread. Its large muscles flex and bulge as it stomps around on the ground, but it still only stands around four feet tall. It is cute and dangerous all at the same time.

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: A half-furry man beginning to grow fangs is lumbering about.
mobLongDesc: A large male stands almost seven feet in the air even though he is hunched over. His legs are bulging outwards as muscle tears through the pant legs and his shoes have been shredded by large feet and claws that emerge from the ripped soles. Large gray hairs start poking out of the bottom half of his body, covering his lower back, legs and feet with hair. The face begins to elongate and small fangs start to make their frightful appearance.

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: A Stone Statues sits staring at the ceiling
mobLongDesc: Large stone ears sit on top of a stone face, forever stuck with the same forlorn expression. The stone is smooth and has a gray matte color. It looks expertly carved as there are no cracks or blemishes on the stone.

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: A Large Demon paces the room
mobLongDesc: Black Horns cover his face as they extend upwards. The four separate points form an odd square in relation to the fangs jutting from his mouth. The red skin blends into the black skin covering his folded wings.

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: A Scaled Lizard flicks its tongue
mobLongDesc: A large orange and green lizard slowly moves about the room, flicking a forked tongue to and from all the other creatures in the room. Its large, bulbous eyes rotate independently watching in all directions, watching for anything delicious to cross its path.

zoneName: Dark Spire, by Oceana and Zorak
mobShortDesc: A Robed man walks around the room.
mobLongDesc: A tiny man covered in a standard white lab coat runs around the room in a hectic fashion. Holding both vials and jars of random ingredients, he tosses them into boiling pots as ramblings continue to spurt from his mouth. The areas around his face show that goggles are used at times, as there are rings of soot around them.

mobLongDesc: Purple energy pours out of the large pulsing ball of energy. Light is absorbed into its all black core as its body takes form. Hollow eyes, black as its core form in what appears to be its head.
