mobShortDesc: A cute little taraun moves about, grazing on the abundant vegetation.
mobLongDesc: This is a cute little animal that would do nicely as a pet.  Although tarauns have quite the temper when angered, they tend to stay to themselves and graze quietly unless disturbed.  They move about quickly and quietly and seem to be focused on devouring every tasty morsel they can find.

mobShortDesc: An Endmed is here grazing, not seeming to pay any heed to its surroundings.
mobLongDesc: Endmeds are large creatures that walk about on four legs and consume everything in their path like a living vacuum.  Its mouth spends much of the time almost buried into the ground, rooting for the choicest parts of plants to eat as it grazes. Its eyes look about lazily, never seeming to be very concerned about its surroundings or any possibility of danger.

mobShortDesc: A giant endaredichon is here, stamping its huge legs on the grass.
mobLongDesc: This is a very large and ponderous beast not found native to any other land outside of Emithoynarthe.  It looks pleasant enough and does not seem to mind the presence of other creatures.  However, it looks like it could be very dangerous in a fight if it were angered or disturbed in a violent way.

mobShortDesc: A centaur is stomping proudly here, not taking notice to your presence.
mobLongDesc: This mystical creature has the torso of a man on top of a complete horses body. He strides around on all four hooves and watches over the smaller forest creatures. Many centaurs were troublemakers and gave the breed a reputation for disorderly conduct. They got drunk, kidnapped maidens and started fights. Even so, people consider centaurs to be a symbol of all that is good and right in the world. Although they are hidden from they untrained eye, centaurs don't hide from people. When you spot and approach him he stays standing stout and proud.
affectedByFlags: PROTECT-EVIL INFRAVISION DODGE SNEAK HIDE DUAL

mobShortDesc: A satyr shyly hides from you in a bush nearby.
mobLongDesc: From the waist down this amazing creature is a goat. Above the waist he is a very shy, kind and gentle man. Satyrs are lovers of the forest who guard it's safety with their lives. They are held by the people as symbols of peace and good fortune.
affectedByFlags: INVISIBLE PROTECT-EVIL INFRAVISION DODGE SNEAK HIDE DUAL

mobShortDesc: A minotaur stomps wildly, shaking the very ground you walk on.
mobLongDesc: This creature is very powerful and intimidating. It has a bull's head atop the very large and strong body of a man. It stomps wildly on the ground causing the earth to tremble. Minotaur's are very territorial and very easily angered. They are widely feared by mortal men and rumored to be the cause of most earthquakes.

mobShortDesc: A wild deer stops grazing and eyes you suspiciously
mobLongDesc: This is a fully matured doe. She is very sleek and slender and without a scar or blemish. She appears to be doing very well in this forest area.

mobShortDesc: Nyla the Nymph is floating about the forest, humming a sweet tune.
mobLongDesc: Nyla is one of the many forest nymphs. The Nymphs are miniscule fairies who strive to protect the forest and the natural balance that exists in it. Nyla is the only fairy trusting enough to allow herself to be seen by mortals, while the rest of her kind hide in their natural environment. She has tiny translucent wings, a bright pinkish skin tone, and bright yellow hair. She is wearing a tiny jeweled dress and matching tiara. She smiles at you brightly and continues on her way, humming merrily.

mobShortDesc: A small rabbit is peeking out at you from under a shrub.
mobLongDesc: He is a small, grayish rabbit with both ears raised alertly. His nose twitches intermittently as he sizes you up as friend or foe.

mobShortDesc: Pan, the god of the forest, stands here playing a melody on his flute.
mobLongDesc: Pan is the god of the forest. He protects the delicate balance of all the plants and creatures. He is a satyr himself, a man's torso on a goat's body, and he loves to stand on the bank of this mystical lake and play melodies on his special flute.
affectedByFlags: SPHERE PROTECT-EVIL INFRAVISION DODGE SNEAK DUAL

mobShortDesc: The Guardian of the Gateway is here, keeping the unworthy from passing.
mobLongDesc: The Guardian of the Gateway wears a full crimson robe that covers all of the body that you assume him to have. His arms are folded before him with his hands hidden by the baggy sleeves. The hem of the robe reaches the ground, but doesn't look at all soiled. He towers over you by a few feet. You can't tell by looking at him and the surroundings if he just got here or if he has been standing here for a thousand years.

mobShortDesc: A powerful Enfan guard is here, protecting Orshingal.
mobLongDesc: The Enfan guard maintains an air of authority within Ershteep; even though enfans are known for their kindness, they tend to be very protective of Orshingal and one another. Resting on the Enfan guard's shoulders is a shirt of worn chainmail. With a pike in hand, he readily awaits any troublemakers. Despite his duty as a guard, he has the same welcoming face that all enfans seem to wear amiably.

mobShortDesc: An enfan citizen strolls happily about, enjoying his simple life.
mobLongDesc: This relatively petite humanoid wanders rather aimlessly but cheerfully through Ershteep. Wearing simple clothes and an amicable grin, he saunters about without a care in the world.

mobShortDesc: An attractive young enfan citizen is here, whistling to herself.
mobLongDesc: Sauntering through the streets on her casual daily walk, this attractive enfan smiles innocently at a passerby. She appears to be slightly taller than a halfling, except that she has a much gentler face and presence. She wears simple clothes and continues about her business without paying much attention to you.

mobShortDesc: The Enfan Baker urges customers to purchase some of his goods.
mobLongDesc: Significantly more robust than the average enfan, the baker has obviously had his fair share of his tasty treats. Cheerful and welcoming, he smiles at every person that walks through the door in hopes of making yet another sale. He wears a remarkably clean apron, and a chef's hat perched atop his head, which waves about as he shuffles around behind the counter.

mobShortDesc: The warlock toils with the magical creations sold at this shop.
mobLongDesc: Cloaked in the loose-fitting robes of a magician, the warlock shuffles across the wooden floor methodically. This mystical enfan's eyes are hidden within the shadow from his sorcerer's cap, but his welcoming voice bellows from deep in his belly. Although seemingly aloof at times, the warlock is renowned throughout the land for his friendly services and his ardent dedication to his craft.

mobKeywords: jarve enfan owner jovial restauranteur restaurant
mobShortDesc: A jovial enfan strolls around his restaurant greeting customers.
mobLongDesc: Jarve's portly belly sticks out from beneath his tight, simple clothing. Slightly over-sized for an enfan, Jarve doubles as not only the owner of his restaurant but also as the bouncer. His rumbling laughter shakes the furniture in the room. He welcomes any and all visitors to his restaurant, passed down through his family for ages.

mobShortDesc: A rather important looking enfan rests comfortably in his chair.
mobLongDesc: Resting comfortably in a fluffy chair at his desk, the mayor sits authoritatively doing absolutely nothing. Despite being relatively lazy, he has done wonderful things for the city of Orshingal, and all enfans. As the son of the previous mayor, he is expected to continue the lineage and bear a child to take his place. For now though, he seems healthy and happy as he governs the enfans. Although the mayor is considerably older and wiser than most, it does not show in his face, or stature. Like all enfans he is constantly smiling and has young, childish features. Noticing your presence, he nods his head in welcome.

mobShortDesc: Running around playfully, a child narrowly avoids being stepped on.
mobLongDesc: A small enfan child smiles widely at you, regarding you as he does all the tourists and travellers that frequent Orshingal. Although clearly a young teen, his face looks remarkably baby like which must be some characteristic of enfan youth.

mobShortDesc: Peering around curiously, looking lost, a star-nosed mole pouts.
mobLongDesc: Matted fur with clumps of dirt cover the entire mole's body. Although seemingly harmless, the claw marks on the wall indicate a more ferocious beast than a quick glance might reveal. The mole seems ambivalent to your presence in his burrow, and continues to wallow in despair.

mobShortDesc: Walking about solemnly, an enfan priest studies some ancient texts.
mobLongDesc: Wrapped in a silky white robe with intricate embroidery, this devoted enfan focuses his attention on the pages of the book in his hands. This particular enfan has dedicated his life to the church, and looks after the chapel night and day, always wary of evil and its followers. Although he has a slightly more serious look on his face, you still detect a hint of a smile beneath his purposeful gaze. As he walks, he basks in the warmth of a holy aura surrounding his body and soul.
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST

mobKeywords: fyona wife barkeep tender bar bartender
mobShortDesc: Fyona the barkeep scrubs some mugs clean while tending the bar.
mobLongDesc: A gorgeous enfan stares at you through the bottom of a glass mug as she checks its cleanliness. Fyona, Jarve's wife, runs their bar, in many cases, with an iron fist. After years of dealing with troublesome adventurers pumped full of too much ale, she's become a rather battle-hardened enfan.

mobShortDesc: Mumbling incoherently to himself, a very drunk dwarf pounds another ale.
mobLongDesc: This poor dwarf must have been in here a while, judging from all the empty mugs at his table. He barely has the strength to keep his head up as he wavers back and forth with each small movement. The somewhat humorous sight of the dwarf chatting to himself as he pours ale down the front of his beard brings a smile to your face.

mobShortDesc: Eternally cursed, this misty spirit haunts the underground library.
mobLongDesc: Wispy trails of a gloomy mist form the ethereal shape of an enfan. Centuries old, cursed by the very gods they worshipped, these sorrowful souls long for a release from their misery.
mobImmune: PUMMEL KICK PUNCH BACKSTAB AMBUSH ASSAULT

mobShortDesc: Withered by his possession, the dark priest utters incantations quietly.
mobLongDesc: Consumed by the hatred of the gods he once worshipped, this dark priest has become possessed by the forces of darkness. Although the curse has kept him alive for centuries, his soul has died, leaving nothing but a vacant hole which has filled with despair over time. He is an aberration, disfigured by evil and consumed by hatred, his only wish is to condemn others to the life he leads.

mobShortDesc: A crazed enfan mutters to himself while fumbling with some vials.
mobLongDesc: Clad in a make-shift jacket made from an old throw-rug, this enfan appears to have been awake for weeks. A look of fierce intensity fills his eyes with wariness and rage. His hair is a tangled mess of Gordian proportions. Beakers and vials of multi- colored potions stick out of pockets which seem to cover his entire jacket.

mobShortDesc: An awkwardly large mouse plods around here, unsure of his surroundings.
mobLongDesc: The potion used by Elago to enlarge this poor rodent lacked the purity of elvish concoctions, which has caused the mouse's features to be strangely disproportional to its original stature. The abrupt change in scenery has startled and alarmed the mouse, coupled with the potion's attitudinal ingredients it has left the furry rodent bubbling with fury. He grinds his now enormous teeth grind loudly together as he rhythmically slams his tail against the wooden floorboards.

mobShortDesc: A cute receptionist whistles as she happily sorts stacks of papers.
mobLongDesc: A beautiful young enfan smiles confidently back at you. She has been welcoming personal guests of the mayor's and tourists, travellers, and adventurers to Orshingal for some time, yet still she seems excited by every new face to come through her door. In her time here she's had to deal with all manner of troublemakers, and her features reveal at least remedial combat training.

mobShortDesc: A flaming effigy swirls around, phasing in and out of corporeal form.
mobLongDesc: Flames swirl and twist constantly, briefly forming corporeal features of a horned, firey daemon. The room seems to swell and boil as the daemon flexes its grotesque form. Summoned from the depths of hell, this horror of the underworld came into being through the dark magic of the pagan Enfans of olde. As far as you can tell,

mobShortDesc: Cloaked in green, an elven tourist wanders the city streets.
mobLongDesc: A pointy-eared, young face peers back at you from beneath a green hat. Wearing a tunic and a brilliant forest-green cloak he tours the streets of Orshingal. On his belt he has a thin scabbard with a short but fierce-looking sword.

mobShortDesc: A gambler lacking a shirt pounds his fists on the table.
mobLongDesc: Shirtless, and from the looks of things, soon to be pantless as well, this unfortunate gambler has had a turn of bad luck. His face is hidden behind his hands, unable to bring himself to watch as the cards are dealt. It stands to reason that he is still here only because he can't afford to get anywhere with what he has left. Under his breath he mutters about "One last long shot" and how that will bring him back into the good graces of Lady Luck.

mobShortDesc: A gambler wearing two shirts and a smug grin, plays with his chips.
mobLongDesc: With a gem-encrusted belt, and a silk cloak wrapped around his shoulders, this gambler must surely be winning incredible sums of money. Some of the stacks of chips in front of him look to be shoulder-high to a halfling. He fastidiously counts his money over and over again as if worried it will have walked away when he wasn't paying attention.

mobShortDesc: After shuffling, an enfan with a visor deals cards to the table.
mobLongDesc: The rake in Jarve's casino is a considerable tax on the play judging by the quality of dress which the dealer is afforded. Dressed in a neatly pressed frilly shirt, and a smooth-cut pair of silk pants, he exudes style. Marked by the traditional attire of a dealer - a red garter on his left sleeve, and a slightly tinted visor - he sits comfortably at the table slowly raking in significant percentages of every pot.

mobShortDesc: A chubby enfan rushes about, his chef's hat teetering as he runs.
mobLongDesc: A puff-cheeked enfan's smile shines through a flour-spattered face. Clad in a blue-green plaid apron and a stained chef's hat, this tubby enfan is the mastermind behind all of the bakery's delights. Clearly he taste-tests the merchandise himself, since his figure is much more robust than the average enfan. It also seems that he is sporting a loaf of banana bread as shoes...

mobShortDesc: A surly rooster crows loudly while clawing the ground angrily.
mobLongDesc: Capped by a bright red comb and wattle, this young cockerel appears to be a trained fighter. There's a possibility that Elago has begun dangerous and diabolical experiments on this aggressive bird. If so, lord help whosoever encounters it once Elago's hand has tainted its behavior with his demented alchemy.

mobShortDesc: A Dying Drider is lying here immobile and helpless.
mobLongDesc: This poor creature seems to have been cursed with bad luck twice over, not only was it damned to spent its days trapped in its abominable form, but it seems to have been caught in this passageway during the last cave-in. Its legs are hopelessly shattered beneath it, and its thorax split open wide, greenish fluids oozing from it, slowly ebbing away the pitiful creature's life. As you raise your blade to end its suffering, it tries to rasp out some words with its last breath.....

mobShortDesc: The Leader of this Patrol is standing here, barking out orders.
mobLongDesc: Armed with a pair of weapons, this dark figure appears to be leading a drow patrol party around the city limits, making sure all is in order.  Apparently, he doesn't take your presence here as common and quickly screams out orders to his patrol...

mobShortDesc: The patrol's cleric is here, chanting something under her breath.
mobLongDesc: Flanking behind the leader of the patrol, this priestess of Dagoor chants a few verses and waits for the right moment to unleash her fury.

mobLongDesc: A dark, shadowy figure lurks around here -- very aware of your presence and quickly moves into a well-rehearsed battle stance.

mobShortDesc: a green vine waits amongst his brothers, seeking to grasp a victim in wake.
mobLongDesc: This green vine stretches from within the tunnel walls, trying to grasp you with it's fine green handle.  You try to avoid it's hold, but underestimate it's strength.  Now this overgrowth has a firm grip on your leg and the other grip around your mouth...
actionFlags: SENTINEL ISNPC AGGRESSIVE AGGEVIL AGGGOOD AGGNEUT

mobShortDesc: A sleek, muscular panther paces about here.
mobLongDesc: Featureless and non-descript, the blank of primal clay waits for someone to breath life into it.

mobShortDesc: A beautiful white-maned unicorn trots around here.
mobLongDesc: Featureless and non-descript, the blank of primal clay waits for someone to breath life into it.

mobShortDesc: Swirling into place is a purple haze, heeding the call of Dagoor.
mobLongDesc: Materializing before you as a wave of purple gas, this Yochlol takes form and heeds the call of it's master, the Spider Queen.  Armed with flailing tentacles and vicious razor-sharp teeth, this adversary from the outer planes is a formidable opponent.

mobShortDesc: An Eight-Legged Arachnid form shambles around, seeking to quench it's bloodlust.
mobLongDesc: These strange creatures have the head and torso of a drow and the legs and lower body of a giant spider.  Only Dagoor, the dark goddess, can create such abominations -- usually done for the sake of punishment of disloyalty, real or perceived. Because they live under Dagoor's displeasure, these driders are outcasts from their own communities and thus are forced to find home elsewhere.  Known to be violent and aggressive, they favor blood over all types of food, stalking their victims in relentless fashion.

mobShortDesc: A Carrion Crawler scurries around here, searching for disposed carcasses.
mobLongDesc: Feeding mainly upon rotting corpses, these carrion crawlers can be thought of as scavengers of the subterranean abode.  Unfortunately, when such food becomes scarce, these monstrous beings will not hesitate to attack and kill the living.  A fetid odor accompanies these beasts, followed quickly by the slender, writhing tentacles which lash out from the head to paralyze it's victims. Be wary of this creature and take caution to stay out of it's path.
actionFlags: SCAVENGER ISNPC AGGRESSIVE STAY-ZONE MEMORY AGGCO

mobShortDesc: A Huge, Muscular Drider roams around here, whip in hand.
mobLongDesc: Dagoor has appoint this fellow, Garaek as her overseer among the mists of the drider community.  He is a drider himself, muscular in frame and takes no sh*t from anyone.  If anyone tries anything to displease his queen, he will make sure that individual feels much pain, Garaek style.
affectedByFlags: DETECT-INVISIBLE SENSE-LIFE SANCTUARY SPHERE INFRAVISION DODGE DUAL

mobShortDesc: A Wyrm of the Deep roams around here, itching to devour some flesh.
mobLongDesc: You make out from what appears to be a grayish skinned wyrm, about 10 feet in diameter, dragging it's heavy body around -- constantly digging at the tunnel walls. It seems to ignore you and happily digs away at rock, however all those preconceptions are thrown out the window once it notices you.

mobShortDesc: A Denizen of the Lower Planes is standing here, flames scorching from his brow.
mobLongDesc: Before you stands a ten-armed flaring red demon with two sharp protruding horns. He is Glabrezu, the denizen summoned from the lower planes by Dagoor herself to protect this chamber from any unwanted intruders.  He complies with any wishes the Spider Goddess may want from him and sits here waiting for foolish victims that to stumble in.  His specialty is snapping off heads from torsos and eating their brains for dinner.

mobShortDesc: A Colossal Wyrm rests here, blood dripping from its jaw.
mobLongDesc: Twenty feet in diameter and grotesque in appearance, this huge body of a wyrm is a sight to behold.  You can feel the constant shifting of weight when it moves about, shaking the tunnels for miles.  It doesn't appear to have eyes of any kind, but it's jaws are quite sharp -- and if you don't move out of this lair anytime soon, you will be grinded up flesh under his jagged teeth.

mobShortDesc: A slender drow female is here, red blazing a ruby red
mobLongDesc: Her red gaze is too much for you to resist as you look into her eyes and see a sad smile.  You drop your guard as you are mesmerized by her beauty, and turn to stone where you stand.  The sounds of your sword clanking on the floor is the last thing you hear...
affectedByFlags: DETECT-INVISIBLE SENSE-LIFE SANCTUARY SPHERE INFRAVISION STATUE DODGE PROTECT-GOOD INVUL

mobShortDesc: a midget two-headed koala bear is roaming around here in her thin hula skirt.
mobLongDesc: Tugging on your leg is a cute koala bear in a hot pink skirt, asking you want some lemonade.  She carries a wooden tray full of drinks and wears a flower bonnet on her head.  Tripping over her own two feet, she quickly composes herself and giggles with a sly wink.

mobShortDesc: The Arachnid Queen is resting upon her throne, basking in her power.
mobLongDesc: As you look into the face of a goddess, she looks back at you, with a vengeance.  Don't you know it's blasphemy to stare at such power before you die?  You can contemplate your mistakes now, as a stone figure.
affectedByFlags: DETECT-INVISIBLE SENSE-LIFE SANCTUARY SPHERE INFRAVISION STATUE DODGE INVUL

mobLongDesc: Made from all bone, this little thing has a bone to pick with you.

mobLongDesc: Before you stands a proud gnome warrior.  He appears to be out of breath, but grinning mightily after slaying the last of the skeletal warriors.  He is a seasoned warrior and a veteran with the blade.

mobLongDesc: Standing tall above you is the King of the Myconids.  He doesn't seem to notice your presence and goes about his business.  His height is impressive, and the way he just snapped that boulder in half is pretty impressive as well. He doesn't care for your entrance, just don't mess with him...

mobLongDesc: You laughed at the sight of a puny koala bear.  Are you laughing now?

mobShortDesc: An Orc slave is standing here, cringing in fear at your approach.
mobLongDesc: This pathetic orc slave screams in horror as you approach him.  He tries to scurry away and thinks by hiding behind a rock that he is safe in this drowish community. You almost feel sorry for the thing, for slaves of any kind are whipping posts for its master.

mobShortDesc: a drow soldier walks around here, making his rounds.
mobLongDesc: Peering from above his perched Lizard mount, this drow rider does his routine runs about the city.  He is armed with a sharp dirk, and a cowl behind his hooded cloak.  His sight is keen and sharp, and always on the lookout for intruders.  He always checks over his shoulders for backstabbers and trots slowly with his lizard.

mobShortDesc: With a twirl of his cape, this drow elf reveals his concealed weapons.
mobLongDesc: This Drow elf isn't a commoner by any sense.  Raised in a powerful ranked house, this drow carries along a class which has importance in this city's hierarchy.  I'd beware if I were you, drow nobles are given the finest education in butchering 101.

mobShortDesc: A Powerful Spellcaster stands here, deep in a trance.
mobLongDesc: A black hood draped over his face, this dark elf looks extremely dangerous and could very well kill you with a single word.  Levitating in mid air, he studies you calmly, trying to figure out how you got into his humble home.
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST

mobShortDesc: A Drow Priestess is standing here, snarling in rage!
mobLongDesc: These dark elves are the daughters of the house's matron mother, and after decades of intensive discipline and training, they attain the ranks of priestess and high priestess of Dagoor.  In this matriarchal society, it is only the women who has the upper hand and it is they that are the more feared gender, for the females attain the more powerful spells under Dagoor's omnipotent guidance.

mobShortDesc: A drow donned in black robes is here, his hands outstretched.
mobLongDesc: Eyes closes and hands swirling in the air in silent trance, this drow elf is in the mists of casting a powerful spell.  Apparently, his job is to recharge the stone pillar in the center of town -- the time clock of the drow elves, and is not aware of any dangers surrounding him.  This is a routine trip by drow standards and only apprentices embark on this opportunity for practice.

mobShortDesc: The Weaponmaster of Tzjar-Fey is here, crouched in a fighting stance.
mobLongDesc: Armed with dueling scimitars, this drow elf is extremely dangerous and carries the reputation of the best killer in his craft.  Scars and battle wounds cover his body, along with a muscular build and sharp eye which makes him most feared in the realm of the drow.  Snarling fiercely at you, he charges!

mobShortDesc: A Matron Mother of a lower house is here, screaming out orders.
mobLongDesc: Bellowing and screaming in rage, this matron mother does not look happy.  You have violated her house and now she will look to end your pitiful existence.

mobShortDesc: A Drow Matron Mother rests here high upon her throne.
mobLongDesc: This is the fabled matron mother of the first house of Eryndlyn.  She has been here since the dawn of the city's birth and looks as if she can withstand another major turn in the city's history.  Matron Tzjar-Fey looks to be tired, but strong in her ways of Dagoor.  She is 6 centuries old, but drow history records her younger than her actual age.  She sits on her throne, fuming and diabolical, wondering why intruders are in her private chambers.
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST

mobShortDesc: A one-eyed, ten-tentacle monstrosity hovers before you, arms crossed.
mobLongDesc: Not much is known about the illithids, however, they are dangerous adversaries by reputation for they can easily control the weak-mined and naive.  They are known simply as the "mind-flayers" and they can destroy you with one thought. They stand about 6 feet tall, with hideous mauve skin that glistens with slime. The head is octopus-like with a single eye and ten dangling tentacles.  They are also known for their skill in magic and battle tactics.
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST

mobLongDesc: This pathetic goblin screams in horror as you approach him.  He tries to scurry away and thinks by hiding behind a rock that he is safe in this drowish community. You almost feel sorry for the thing, for slaves of any kind are whipping posts for its master.

mobShortDesc: A Drow Matron Mother rests here high upon her throne.
mobLongDesc: You are looking upon the eyes of the third ranked Matron mother of this city.  Yjarrm, old, but a resourceful Matron mother, has been in the ranks of third for practically all of her existence.  Her house is well respected and has a nice complement of forces at her command.  However, Yjaarm has lost her fire and desire to fight -- a fault in her trait which could lead to her demise.

mobShortDesc: A Drow Matron Mother rests here high upon her throne.
mobLongDesc: You are looking upon the eyes of the fourth ranked Matron mother of this city.  Quehvar, a young matron mother by drow standards, has a hungry desire to move up in rank.  Known for her vicious fire in battle, she is also a persistent political figure in the drow ranks.  Most undoubtedly, we can expect high things in the future from this dark elf.

mobShortDesc: A Drow Matron Mother rests here high upon her throne.
mobLongDesc: You are looking upon the eyes of the second ranked Matron mother of this city.  She is wise beyond her years and vast are her powers.  Zaboral-Hashal has seen much and will watch for her opportunity to move into the first rank.  Laughing diabolically, she knows her time will come when she will reign at the very top. Chaos rules this society, friendship and peace are irrelevant.

mobShortDesc: The Leader of this Patrol is standing here, barking out orders.
mobLongDesc: Armed with a pair of weapons, this dark figure appears to be leading a drow patrol party around the city limits, making sure all is in order.  Apparently, he doesn't take your presence here as common and quickly screams out orders to his patrol...

mobShortDesc: A Spider roams around the entrance of this compound, seeking intruders.
mobLongDesc: Crawling around here is the appointed spider of this house.  Endowed with sharp fangs, eight legs and a savage attitude -- this spider guard wont give up his position of the gate.

mobShortDesc: a spider crawls along the floor here, pincers seeking blood.
mobLongDesc: They are nicknamed "soul spiders" because they are the servants of Dagoor summoned from her dark extraplanar domain by rituals of worship and supplication to the Spider Goddess.  They are tireless hunters, often discovering their own gates or portals to other planes.  Vicious and cruel in their attacks on weaker creatures, myrlochar act as though they are on a perpetual hunting and killing spree -- till they encounter an opponent strong enough to slay them.

mobShortDesc: A deep gnome is standing here happily, mining the stone.
mobLongDesc: This deep gnome loves his art, and that art is mining the rock of these caverns. Completely hairless, this short creature of the dark is much in tune with the stone.  It is said that these gnomes have the power to call upon the powers of stone elements to aid them battle, especially with the drow city not far away from this location.  They are fearless fighters, though you cannot picture them as being violent.

mobShortDesc: A Towering Rock Elemental is here, watching over the gnomes.
mobLongDesc: Created from the ashes and rock of the earth, this elemental watches over the gnome camp from drow invaders.  Blue flames flashes from his eyes, arms crosses and standing tall -- this guardian looks very intimidating.

mobShortDesc: A Duergar Dwarf is here with his caravan, ready to move into city limits.
mobLongDesc: Before you stands a devious grinning dark dwarf, bring his wares into Eryndlyn looking for a market.  He knows that dealing with such a dangerous race is hazardous to his health, but worth the riches if he succeeds in selling his products.

mobName: Statue of Dagoor the Arachnid Queen
mobShortDesc: [1] A Jade Statue of the Arachnid Queen looms here, guarding the city gates.
mobLongDesc: These animated stone constructs are guarding the border of their city. They might look and seem inanimate, but their sense are keen and can kill you if you try to pass through these gates.  They possess sharp-tipped mandibles and their saw-edged legs are studded with a magical treated jade. Their eyes look vacant and undisturbed, but in actually, they never stop moving, scanning the area for intruders and unwanted guests.
affectedByFlags: DETECT-INVISIBLE SENSE-LIFE PROTECT-EVIL INFRAVISION PROTECT-GOOD DUAL FURY

mobShortDesc: A Huge Lizard paces around here, diligently waiting for his master.
mobLongDesc: Green scaled and two sharp horns, this fine creature makes for a good riding mount in the underground.  He shows signs of intelligence as you into his eyes -- almost telling you to watch who you fight, for he seems confident in kicking your ass.

mobShortDesc: From the shadows emerges a drow elf, weapons blazing a red hue.
mobLongDesc: Hiding his face in the dark, this looming figure marks your every move -- watching you with his innate ability of infravision.  He seems to be following you for some reason unknown and doing a good job, for you have not detected any trackers tagging behind.  Before completing your next thought, this dark elf draws his weapons and greets your with a snarl.

mobShortDesc: A figure in the shadows examines you coolly, hands caressing a hidden weapon.
mobLongDesc: Hiding in the shadows, this slender drow elf studies you in the corner. However, in a short while reveals himself and wields his short-sword. Growling and waving his weapon dangerously, you back away.  Maybe you should reconsider fighting such a powerful foe.

mobShortDesc: A Spider roams around the entrance of this compound, seeking intruders.
mobLongDesc: Crawling around here is the appointed spider of this house.  Endowed with sharp fangs, eight legs and a savage attitude -- this spider guard wont give up his position of the gate.

mobShortDesc: The House Wizard of Yjarrm is sitting here, juggling balls of flame.
mobLongDesc: Only a small novice in the art of spellcasting, this so called wizard feverishly conducts his experiments, hoping to revolutionize the world...

mobShortDesc: A Spider roams around the entrance of this compound, seeking intruders.
mobLongDesc: Crawling around here is the appointed spider of this house.  Endowed with sharp fangs, eight legs and a savage attitude -- this spider guard wont give up his position of the gate.

mobShortDesc: A Spider roams around the entrance of this compound, seeking intruders.
mobLongDesc: Crawling around here is the appointed spider of this house.  Endowed with sharp fangs, eight legs and a savage attitude -- this spider guard wont give up his position of the gate.

mobShortDesc: A Huge Mushroom-Stalk shambles around here.
mobLongDesc: This mushroom walks around mindlessly and without any indication of contentment from life.  They are impressively huge however, towering a good 10 feet tall.  However, they seem a little green around the edges...
actionFlags: SCAVENGER ISNPC WIMPY MEMORY ARM SHIELD

mobShortDesc: Stationed here is a slender drow elf, weapons drawn.
mobLongDesc: A glint of light flashes from this elfish descendant's eye, grinning at you with evil intent.  Once, dark elves were a part of the elven race which roamed the world's forests, but their selfish inclinations and fascination with the ways of evil caused a civil war amongst the elves.  Eventually, these drow elves were forced into the depths of the earth, and since then few have seen a dark elf. Hopefully you will live this encounter, for they are a merciless race.

mobShortDesc: An evil orc stands here, grinning at you.
mobLongDesc: An evil orc is grinning at you.  There are flecks of foam around his mouth. Maybe he is rabid.  Now isn't that a cheerful thought.  Running is always an option.

mobShortDesc: An evil merchant is here ready for battle.
mobLongDesc: This is not your usual merchant.  This merchant is large, strong and looks like he has had to fight for a profit more than once.

mobShortDesc: Ripper, a huge statue, towers over you.
mobLongDesc: Ripper's eyes glow as you look at it.  It is truly the epitome of evil. And its face...  Just looking at it makes you rigid with fear.  Wait a second you are getting rigid but it is not from fear...  Maybe looking at Riper was not such a good idea.

mobShortDesc: A large Orc stands here, he has many battle scars.
mobLongDesc: This orc has seen lots of battles.  The number of his scars and the fact that he is here means he won lots of battles too.  Yep, he definitely looks tough.

mobShortDesc: A huge rat is here gnawing on old pizza crusts.
mobLongDesc: Ok.  It is a really big rat.  It is about the size of a saint-bernard!

mobShortDesc: A fiery bushboogie is here plotting your death!
mobLongDesc: ARGH!!  You can not really see it closely, but you know it is composed of fire.  And you know it is fast.

mobShortDesc: A rat is here getting crumbs off the floor.
mobLongDesc: Hey, it is a rat ok?  You know, small, black, little red eyes...

mobShortDesc: Stranger, the guardian of Ripper, has arrived and attacks!
mobLongDesc: Stranger is dressed in dark robes and a mask and hood.  You can not really make out his features.  But his sword looks deadly!  Have you considered leaving?

mobShortDesc: A huge gnoll stands here picking his teeth.
mobLongDesc: Yep this is a gnoll.  You can tell because it looks like a humanoid jackal. Smells like one too.  Still, he looks pretty tough.

mobShortDesc: The gnoll chieftain is here, howling with rage!!
mobLongDesc: This is the toughest looking gnoll you have ever seen.  He is huge. And his weapon's belt is loaded with scalps.  He must be favored by his evil gods.

mobShortDesc: The chr-eff'n are crawling here, looking around with it's yellow eyes.
mobLongDesc: The head and torso of a chr-eff'n is copper-covered, with yellow ,glowing eyes. The lower body is in an orange shading.

mobShortDesc: The morkoth are standing here, waiting for someone to KILL!
mobLongDesc: It's a five feet tall, shadow monster. This has the shape between a human and a rat. It breaths very heavily, while it stares at you.

mobShortDesc: Madam Esther is standing here, trying to sell dust.
mobLongDesc: She is very big standing here, smiling to you. She looks like the mother of the town, sometimes playing with the children, sometimes helping the old people, with their daily work. All this in spite of her own hard work.

mobShortDesc: The Red fierce-looking dragon stares at you angrily
mobLongDesc: The red dragon stares at you, angrily, as it wakes when you arrives.  It says 'Oh, human YOU woke me up...Hsssss', while it moves closer ,'Can one NEVER sleep in peace..Hssss'.

mobShortDesc: The Sea Hag is swimming around here
mobLongDesc: The sea hag is so ghastly looking that you fell's the deepest fear: Big yellow eyes and sharp teeth. Its ears are very big, and it have small sharp horns. This type of monsters are one of the greatest haters of beauty (Next after Medusa).

mobShortDesc: The Guardian Naga looks kindly at you.
mobLongDesc: The naga are a snake-liked creature. She is covered in green-gold scale with silvery triangles along her back. Her eyes are golden. She notice that you look at her, and she says: 'Watch out. This way leads to some evil creatures'.

mobShortDesc: The scaled Basilisk crawls towards you slowly.
mobLongDesc: The basilisk is a reptilian monster. It has eight legs, and a strong toothy jaws. It is dull brown with yellowish underbelly. It's eyes are glowing pale green.

mobShortDesc: A hermit crab scuttles about here, looking for food.
mobLongDesc: This tiny creature has made its dwelling within the shell of some poor conch. All that show from under the shell are two pincers, one larger than the other, and a pair of eyes on stalks. It scuttles sideways along the ground here, pausing occasionally to sniff at a clump of dried seaweed.

mobShortDesc: A fiddler crab waves it pincers rhythmically here.
mobLongDesc: A small crab with a greenish-blue body, the remarkable thing about this crab is the gigantic size difference between one pincer and the other. One of the pincers is minute and almost peripheral, while the other is huge in proportion to the rest of the creature. Always advancing with the large claw facing danger, this little crab is almost menacing.

mobShortDesc: A tiny sand flea hops about on the sand here.
mobLongDesc: This tiny creature looks almost antediluvian, some prehistoric monster shrunk down to a millionth of its size and placed on the beach here. However, all it is is a tiny little crustacean, easily crushed.

mobShortDesc: A twisted dwarf stands here, fuming.
mobLongDesc: This twisted creature looks as if it has never seen the end of the stone age. A long black beard extends from its jaw to the ground, above the beard glitter two tiny black eyes. You see that its teeth have been sharpened somewhat as it opens its mouth. However, under all of this wild exterior you see that this creature is simply some kind of dwarf which has been twisted from its original roots to the strange beast-like thing you see before you.

mobShortDesc: A lost sailor has made a home for himself here.
mobLongDesc: This sad old man makes his living off the detritus thrown off ships and brought to him by the currents of the ocean. He must be a bit daft, however, considering that civilization is so close.

mobShortDesc: An old pirate captain hobbles about on his peg leg here, swearing.
mobLongDesc: From his eyepatch to his peg leg, this grizzled old sea-dog fits the picture-book image of a Pirate Captain. However, this poor fellow seems to have lost his ship and his bearings, as he has made himself a home on this desert beach. The skeleton of a parrot still clutches on to this grey-bearded man's epaulette, and the strange pirate seems to be talking to it.
attackType: SPELL SKILL PUMMEL SPELL CAST SPELL CAST DISARM KICK PUNCH
attackTarget: BUFFER BUFFER SELF SELF BUFFER BUFFER BUFFER

mobShortDesc: A lost pirate is singing badly and doing a mad jig here.
mobLongDesc: This disgusting old pirate cackles as you look at him, displaying a mouth full of black and rotting stumps. He wears tattered rags and a kerchief to cover his balding head. Simple gold and silver jewelry decorate his gigantic, veined red nose and his outrageously large ears. He does an extra-high leap to finish a complex step in his jig, and then breathes his filthy breath on you before continuing.

mobShortDesc: A lost pirate lies in a drunken stupor in a corner here.
mobLongDesc: Alcohol-laden grunts and snores erupt from this revolting piece of human refuse as he sleeps away a massive drinking spree. An eyepatch covers one of his eyes, and he scratches his belly with a tarnished silver hook which substitutes for one of his hands.

mobShortDesc: The first mate of the lost pirates stands here, tapping his wooden leg.
mobLongDesc: This grumpy old pirate is the cleanest of the lot, his brass buttons shiny and his wooden leg recently refinished. He stands in the corner of this room and smokes his pipe, scowling at the antics of his captain's crew. He looks, well, very bored.

mobShortDesc: A cabin boy whistles a merry pirate tune while mopping up some vomit.
mobLongDesc: This silly little boy wears knickers and a white shirt, and cleans up after every mess the pirates make. However, when those pirates were stuck in the doldrums many years ago, they found another use for the cabin boy. His eyes go blank and he starts whimpering when poor little John Thomas remembers how he got to play "diseased whore" on the deck of the ship those years past....

mobShortDesc: A lost child scavenges about here, eyeing you warily.
mobLongDesc: This young child wears rags and seaweed, and looks as though he hasn't bathed in years. Even though he is only a child, you suspect he's quite good at defending himself. After all, he seems to have lived outside of civilization for some time.

mobShortDesc: The Grand Poobah stands here, glaring about haughtily.
mobLongDesc: This young boy of about twelve years wears a tin badge on his chest which is inscribed with the words, "Thee Grannt Pewbah!!" This child is obviously the ruler of the children who dwell on the bluffs, and he actually wears a rusted iron gauntlet on his left hand. A long scar runs down his left cheek and his chest.

mobShortDesc: A long yellow millipede scuttles surreally across the sand here.
mobLongDesc: This hideous insect is at least three feet in length, and glows with an unearthly light. Long pincer-mandibles clack loudly as it rushes towards you across the sand, its hundreds of legs scuttling like mad to create the effect of effortless gliding.

mobShortDesc: A gigantic red-rumped ape searches for grubs under the junk heap.
mobLongDesc: This giant simian has a red rear end and is covered entirely with short, bristly black fur. It has a very pronounced dog-like snout and long, pointed teeth. Its human-like hands are quite capable of clutching simple objects, but they are now busily engaged in scratching the aforementioned red rump.

mobShortDesc: A large plant towers over you here, its fleshy maw gaping.
mobLongDesc: This foul creation is fully eight feet tall, with a bulbous "mouth" well over three feet in diameter. Small, vine-like fronds extend from various points on its trunk, and these wave slowly through the hot air. A small stream of sappy drool dribbles down from one side of the "mouth" as this thing senses your presence.

mobShortDesc: A parrot-like bird perches here, its plumage a shifting red and orange.
mobLongDesc: As you gaze at this bird, you notice that its plumage is an amazingly strange, almost magical variety of reds. As hard as you stare, you cannot stop the pattern's semblance of movement. It almost looks as if this bird is on fire! This effect is aided by the tall crest of red feathers it raises and flutters on the top of its head.
attackType: SPELL SKILL SPELL SKILL SPELL SKILL

mobShortDesc: A gigantic blob of fungus oozes towards you.
mobLongDesc: This awful thing has no visible sensory organs or even limbs. The only way to describe it is, well, as a blob. A fuzzy coating of pale green fungus covers it, except in a few spots where toadstools grow from the creature's body. It seems that somebody must have ensorcelled this once-benign accumulation of small fungal organisms into some kind of guard-beast!

mobShortDesc: A skeletal knight shambles towards you, armor clanking.
mobLongDesc: This strange creature is simply a human skeleton dressed up in a knight's armor and enchanted to defend this tower. Its eyes glow an odd yellowish color through the visor of its helm, and it approaches you with a single obvious purpose in mind: to expel you from this place at all costs. Oddly enough, you notice a dusting rag tucked into its belt.

mobShortDesc: A gigantic furry white bear shambles around here angrily.
mobLongDesc: Fully twelve feet long, this huge bear is completely white, from his nose to his stubby tail. Even the great beast's eyes are white, and the tongue and gums are a pale shade of blue. Probably hailing from the far north of the world, this creature has been tamed somehow and is entrapped in this tower for the sole purpose of guarding the secrets which lie above it.

mobShortDesc: A gigantic spiked toad gazes at you from within the pool.
mobLongDesc: This is one of the largest amphibians you have ever seen, at least seven feet in length. It gazes at you with basilisk eyes from beneath a brow laden with long, horny spikes. Deep green skin pebbled with greyish lumps of horny armor and the odd patch of long spikes make this creature a disgusting and frightening apparition to behold.

mobShortDesc: A large red hunting spider scuttles about on the sand here.
mobLongDesc: This spider is fully two hands across, from leg-tip to leg-tip. Its multifaceted eyes look at you warily as you invade its domain, and you can see venom droplets on the tip of its large mandibles.

mobShortDesc: A short madman wearing a long white coat putters about the lab.
mobLongDesc: A short man wearing a long white coat, this strange madman has grey hair which sticks out at odd angles all over his head. His eyes don't seem to be pointing in the same direction, and a constant stream of drool from his lower lip has encrusted on the lapels of his coat. He mutters something like "hurguk snepat" and bustles towards you with a beaker full of lizard organs in his hand.
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST
attackTarget: BUFFER BUFFER RAN_GROUP RAN_GROUP SELF SELF
attackSpell: lightning_bolt dispel_sanctuary lethal_fire fireball sanctuary heal

mobShortDesc: A whirling cloud of dust flies around here.
mobLongDesc: A gigantic whirling cloud of dust and wind, this strange nether creature is probably what drove poor Yuri mad. Not the greatest sorcerer, the dumb alchemist somehow stumbled upon a way to summon an elemental far too powerful for his meagre skills.
mobImmune: FIRE ELECTRIC PUMMEL KICK PUNCH CHARM BLINDNESS PARALYSIS DISEMBOWEL DISINTEGRATE SUMMON

mobShortDesc: A gigantic creature with eight tentacles swims about in the muck here.
mobLongDesc: A gigantic purplish blob of protoplasm, the only thing that gives this horrendous, filthy creature any definition are its eight tentacles, which radiate from the base of its massive body. Two gleaming yellow eyes stare at you blankly, the slit pupils sideways. You hear some kind of strange clacking sound from somewhere within this beast, and it doesn't sound pleasant.

mobShortDesc: A burly little sea otter trundles along the beach here, leaving webby footprints.
mobLongDesc: This cute little fellow has a pudgy belly, long bristly whiskers, and a zen-like stare on its face. These creatures are generally considered holy by any civilized people because they are obviously connected with some higher plane. This is evidenced by this one's quick little chuckle and mad scratching at its ear.

mobShortDesc: A white beach lizard scuttles along here, almost invisible in the sand.
mobLongDesc: This tiny little lizard must live on whatever small insect happens to be foolish enough to land on the burning white sand of this beach. Almost perfectly camouflaged, you are hard-pressed to even be able to see this tiny lizard.

mobShortDesc: A gigantic, obese black locust lurches towards you here, mandibles dripping.
mobLongDesc: This foul insectoid is fully fifteen feet long, and over seven feet in diameter. Long antennae probe the darkness, and its legs are somehow peripheral. Black armored plates cover its rotund body and give it the aspect of some kind of demon. As a matter of fact, this can only be the legendary Brown Hell Locust, banished to caverns beneath the earth because of their gluttony.
affectedByFlags: DETECT-INVISIBLE SENSE-LIFE SANCTUARY SPHERE PROTECT-EVIL INFRAVISION DODGE PROTECT-GOOD FLY DUAL FURY

mobShortDesc: A Yellow Fido is standing here.
mobLongDesc: It is a level 1 fido.

mobShortDesc: A Blue Fido is standing here.
mobLongDesc: It is a level 2 fido.

mobShortDesc: A Red Fido is standing here.
mobLongDesc: It is a level 3 fido.

mobShortDesc: Your guardian is here taking care of the low level players.
A huge bear of a man stands here with arms crossed, blocking your way.
mobLongDesc: A huge burly man stands tall before you, eyes gazing down trying to make you feel meek.  He is the bouncer of this luxurious establishment, guarding these doors making sure the right people go in and the wrong ones don't.  So don't mess with him, he looks like he has had a very bad day.

mobShortDesc: A Restaurant Attendant sits here diligently waiting on your next order.
mobLongDesc: Dressed in a nicely pressed suit, this elegant looking attendant sits here casually blowing bubble gum.  She waits here impatiently for you to order something, but doesn't seen to care much because she gets paid whether or not you receive your food.

mobShortDesc: A waiter is here, making sure that you are enjoying your stay.
mobLongDesc: A full suit and a pair of thick glasses droop slightly over his nose, this clean-shaven man nods as if annoyed as he swiftly walks over and cleans the tables.  He works long, hard hours -- an expression of boredom is visible on his face, making you wonder if he deserves your tip or not.

mobShortDesc: A waitress is standing here smiling broadly.
mobLongDesc: A bright smile beams on her cute face as she trips over her own feet. Giggling at her own bad luck, Beatrice straightens out her formal dress attire and proceeds to clean tables.

mobShortDesc: A large iron golem stands here.
mobLongDesc: He is large, and metallic.

mobShortDesc: A clay golem stands here.
mobLongDesc: He is large, and ceramic.

mobShortDesc: A stone golem stands here
mobLongDesc: He looks large and granite.

mobShortDesc: A spectre stands here, reaching out for you.
mobLongDesc: He looks sad.

mobShortDesc: A mummy gasps in astonishment at your success thus far.
mobLongDesc: He looks like he wants to change your luck.

mobShortDesc: A statue of Akinra stands here, and blocks your path.
mobLongDesc: He looks really mean.

mobShortDesc: Anubis sits in his throne, wearing a glowing key.
mobLongDesc: He has the body of a man, and the head of a jackal.

mobShortDesc: An ornate chest sits in the corner.
mobLongDesc: It looks well made.

mobShortDesc: A rust monster squats here, eagerly eyeing your armor and weapons.
mobLongDesc: It looks hungry.

mobShortDesc: A black pudding oozes towards you.
mobLongDesc: It is gelatinous and gooey.

mobShortDesc: The nile crocodile swallows the last of his rat appetizer.
mobLongDesc: I bet you're next!

mobShortDesc: The guardian naga slithers toward you to protect her lair.
mobLongDesc: You are intruders, and you must die.

mobShortDesc: The rabid rat scurries towards you.  Its eyes glowing deep red.
mobLongDesc: They scurry into the shadows and attack en-masse.

mobShortDesc: A poor mudder, who is lost in this place.
mobLongDesc: You will become him if you are not careful.

mobShortDesc: A beautiful white star is smiling at you.
mobLongDesc: You can't tell what the star looks like, she is too bright!

mobShortDesc: A young nebula, waiting to become a star.
mobLongDesc: It hasn't got a definite shape, it is just a cloud of mist.

mobShortDesc: A speedy comet, who is waiting to crush your head in.
mobLongDesc: You see the offspring of Halley's comet and it is here just to wipe everything out.

mobShortDesc: An enormous, red supergiant is forced to protect the galaxy.
mobLongDesc: You notice the giant is not as tough as his name sounds...Still he can be very powerful.

mobShortDesc: A white, but tiny dwarf is trying to sneak away from duty.
mobLongDesc: Like the red giant, he is also appointed to stand guard for the galaxy. But somehow he manages to escape. Though tiny,it looks as if it can take a lot of hits!

mobShortDesc: A huge nebula is here, its shape resembles a horsehead.
mobLongDesc: You can only make out its shape from the darkness. He was cursed to stay in here and his face may never be seen by anyone again.

mobShortDesc: The poor Andromeda is chained to the wall, suffering...
mobLongDesc: She was once a princess of beauty. However, her beauty has led to A Goddess' jealousy and she has to suffer here endlessly, 'til the time when Perseus comes.

mobShortDesc: The Mighty Hercules is working hard for his extra Labours for the Gods.
mobLongDesc: He has been put to do the Ten Labours-Ten impossible tasks, by Hera, the queen goddess, who disliked him. But he finished them all and at the end was granted immortality. He is a very brave and strong fighter...don't mess with him.

mobShortDesc: The wild pegasus is grazing peacefully.
mobLongDesc: It is the legendary horse with wings on its back.

mobShortDesc: Orion is still hunting for Scorpio.
mobLongDesc: He is the legendary hunter who almost defeated Taurus the bull, but got killed by Scorpio. The gods put them both up as constellations but one appears on one side of the sky and the other the other side so they will never meet.

mobShortDesc: The Pleiades are here, weeping for the loss of their sisters.
mobLongDesc: These are the seven sisters of the Myths, and as for why they are here, no one knows; even the writer himself has forgotten (couldn't be bothered to look it up).

mobShortDesc: The gigantic Head of Draco lurks out from beneath and prepares to roast you.
mobLongDesc: This evil-looking head is even larger than a giant. He is the last guardian before entering the inner galaxy. His neck is flexing in a random fashion so that hitting the head is certainly not easy.

mobShortDesc: A baby draco is crawling on the Draco's body.
mobLongDesc: You see a tiny creature which looks like a dragon except that its body resembles a snake. Gosh, is this a draco, you wonder, is this the thing we are on now?

mobShortDesc: Aries is sitting here, welcoming you.
mobLongDesc: You see a white goat here, the first guardian of the Zodiac, also the ruler of Spring. He looks as if he is expecting you.

mobShortDesc: Taurus wants to leave, but has been forced to stay as a guardian here.
mobLongDesc: You see a wild-looking bull with a bad temper. He is well-built and looks like he can fight well. Indeed, he has fought with Orion before and survived.

mobShortDesc: Gemini is looking for his brother, have you seen him?
mobLongDesc: As soon as you see him you know that he is the most perfect man you have seen. You can't find any imperfections on him.

mobShortDesc: Gemini is hiding from his brother, grinning evilly at you.
mobLongDesc: As soon as you see him you see the most imperfect man you have ever seen. How can there be such a contrast? You wonder...
actionFlags: SENTINEL SCAVENGER ISNPC AGGRESSIVE STAY-ZONE WIMPY

mobShortDesc: Cancer the crab is here, hoarding the treasure away from you.
mobLongDesc: You see a gigantic crab(YES, it is bigger than you!) with a crushed shell. Legend has it that he was crushed by Hercules when he was sent by Hera to kill him. So Hera made Cancer a constellation for his work.

mobShortDesc: Leo the lion is roaring at you, he is ready for a strike!
mobLongDesc: His metallic skin means that he could be the one which was killed by Hercules during his first Labour. His skin is so weapon-proof that Hercules had to use his bare hands to tear the lion into two from its mouth!

mobShortDesc: Virgo is sitting here, winking at you suggestively..You are alarmed!
mobLongDesc: From what you have seen, you now realize that legends are legends, and Virgo may not be the maid of chastity and purity at all! But still she looks gorgeous and is waiting for your first move, whatever it is...

mobShortDesc: Libra, the fair and just, is staring at you, weighing up the sins of your past.
mobLongDesc: He is a wise old man and can see people's thoughts through their eyes..Now all he can see from you is greed and stupidity.

mobShortDesc: Scorpio is gradually moving his tail towards you, waiting to put an end to some mortals.
mobLongDesc: Ever since he killed Orion in the myths, he has been punished by having Sagittarius' arrow aimed at his heart forever.

mobShortDesc: Sagittarius the centaur is waiting to let go of his well aimed arrow...
mobLongDesc: He is a centaur and more, he is a well trained archer. No one can escape his arrows.

mobShortDesc: Capricorn is here, feeling bored..He wants a fight!
mobLongDesc: You see a mean-looking ram here. He used to be a fierce fighter in the ancient war but now the gods have decided to put him here, to live out the rest of his days in peace.

mobShortDesc: The beautiful Aquarius is standing here, holding THE vessel.
mobLongDesc: The pretty Water Bearer is smiling at you, you think you'd better give her a hand with holding the vessel.

mobShortDesc: Pisces the mermaid is sitting here, waiting for your help.
mobLongDesc: She has been forced to serve her husband, who had been cursed to turn into a fish and she deserves your pity.

mobShortDesc: Pisces the fish, is jealous of your approach...
mobLongDesc: He was once a very handsome man but now has turned into an ugly big fish. So he becomes jealous of any living thing which is more handsome than him. So maybe he is not jealous of you?

mobShortDesc: Ursa Major the bear is the last defense against any intruders..
mobLongDesc: The Huge Bear which resides in the northern skies is here. You think you'd better turn back. At least you have got a chance of survival.

mobShortDesc: Cassiopeia, the queen of the Universe, is sitting on her throne.
mobLongDesc: She is also the Queen of Dignity; facing her, you feel that all your dignity has gone.

mobShortDesc: Cepheus, the king of the Universe, is sitting on his throne.
mobLongDesc: He is the King of Might as well as of the Universe. You suddenly feel very weak and useless in front of him.

mobShortDesc: Polaris, the polar star, who commands the whole Universe, stands before you!
mobLongDesc: He is the Master of the Universe, the most powerful!  Even the King and the Queen obey him. As you look at him you notice he is actually a STAR, with dazzling bright light... Maybe you shouldn't have come here at all?

zoneName: Glacial Tunnels of Remorhaz, by Ursum
mobShortDesc: The Great Ice Burrower itself is here, melting the ice around it.
mobLongDesc: You see a large scaly insectoid. It secretes heat all around it, melting through the ice. It has large bug eyes and a hard underbelly. All of its legs are located within the first third of its massive sixty foot long body, making the rest a sort of tail which it swings with surprising ease.

zoneName: Glacial Tunnels of Remorhaz, by Ursum
mobShortDesc: A large two headed creature with deep blue skin is standing tall here.
mobLongDesc: You see a blue humanoid with two heads. It seems to be completely hairless, but then again you were too sheepish to check under its loins. It has four pure black eyes which always seem to be looking at you.

zoneName: Glacial Tunnels of Remorhaz, by Ursum
mobShortDesc: A large white yeti blends into the snow here.
mobLongDesc: You see a large creature with white fur. It is completely white and almost entirely camouflaged in the snowbank. It has large white fangs and you pray it doesn't have the dexterity necessary to bite you with them.
mobImmune: PUMMEL KICK PUNCH BACKSTAB AMBUSH ASSAULT

zoneName: Glacial Tunnels of Remorhaz, by Ursum
mobShortDesc: A silvery fox with a white tail is on the prowl here.
mobLongDesc: This fox wears thick silver fur and a white tail. It is completely silver aside from its white tail and its white eyes. It is only about three feet long, but with its razor sharp teeth and claws combined with its copious dexterity, it can pack its share of punch.

zoneName: Glacial Tunnels of Remorhaz, by Ursum
mobShortDesc: A small white dragonoid creature flies here, flapping its wings of ice.
mobLongDesc: You see a small white dragonette. Its wings, claws, eyes, and fangs seem to be made of ice. It is rather small but you have a feeling that wouldn't affect its decision to tear you to shreds if you upset it.

zoneName: Glacial Tunnels of Remorhaz, by Ursum
mobShortDesc: A large toad sits here, covered in frost.
mobLongDesc: You see a large frost covered toad. Its skin beneath the frost is a deep blue and its eyes reflect light. Its back is covered in sharp icicles and you would not want to step on it.

zoneName: Glacial Tunnels of Remorhaz, by Ursum
mobShortDesc: A large snake with seven heads slithers through the tunnel here.
mobLongDesc: You see a large blue snake with its body split at the center, where seven separate necks and heads lead out. Each head appears to be a formidable opponent and with such a massive body supporting them, this monster is a deadly combination.

zoneName: Glacial Tunnels of Remorhaz, by Ursum
mobShortDesc: A large white dragon with enormous ice wings is perched here.
mobLongDesc: You see a white dragon whose fangs, claws, and wings appear to be made of ice. It has a wingspan of about fifty feet, and is over sixty feet long, but its entire presence seems difficult to believe. However, you have a feeling it could convince you of its existence with great haste of it so desired.
mobImmune: PUMMEL KICK PUNCH BACKSTAB AMBUSH ASSAULT

zoneName: Glacial Tunnels of Remorhaz, by Ursum
mobShortDesc: A large white bear is hibernating here.
mobLongDesc: You see a large bear with pure bluish-white fur. It blends in very well with the frost and ice of its cave. It has enormous claws and deep blue eyes.

zoneName: Glacial Tunnels of Remorhaz, by Ursum
mobShortDesc: a small creature is here, with soft blue features and translucent wings.
mobLongDesc: This faerie is no more than eighteen inches tall, but it fills the focus of your sight. Its deep blue skin is soft and flowing. Its eyes seem a steady pull into their endless dark. Its wings are barely outlined by the quick flashes of color they reflect.
mobImmune: FIRE ELECTRIC PUMMEL PUNCH BACKSTAB ASSAULT

zoneName: Glacial Tunnels of Remorhaz, by Ursum
mobShortDesc: a small, white, fur-covered creature is here with large fangs.
mobLongDesc: This creature is covered in a thick white fur, and it is hard to discern any of its features through the fur. Its one defining trait is a long hooked fang that gashes out from the blurry fur. The creature moves quickly along the edges of the ice, somehow sliding or gliding on it at incredible speeds.

zoneName: Glacial Tunnels of Remorhaz, by Ursum
mobShortDesc: a rough, stout humanoid is here, standing alert.
mobLongDesc: This creature is vaguely human, with four limbs and opposable thumbs. The creature stands crouched, resting lightly on its fore-limbs, but most of its weight rests on the back. Its eyes are solid dark, and its skin is stretched tight against its large jaw. The creature also has long, firm claws instead of nails.

zoneName: Glacial Tunnels of Remorhaz, by Ursum
mobShortDesc: a rough, sleek humanoid is here, stalking.
mobLongDesc: This creature has a rough human form, with thin quick limbs. It can stand on all four limbs, or only its legs, moving with speed and versatility. It has thick, cupped ears, curved towards the front of its head. Its eyes are solid black, and farther apart than those of a standard humanoid. Its claws are long and thick, and its teeth are rough and sharp.

zoneName: Glacial Tunnels of Remorhaz, by Ursum
mobShortDesc: a thin, smooth humanoid stands naked here, motionless.
mobLongDesc: This humanoid creature is thin and smooth. Her skin is a deep purple and her eyes are empty darkness. She stands still, silent and effortless, floating delicately on the surface of the ice. Her body is flatter than a human's, and her face is longer, stretched across her large jaw. She stands still, aware, alive.

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobShortDesc: A snarak is hiding here, waiting for its next meal.
mobLongDesc: The snarak is a type of parasite commonly associated with goblins.  Every tribe always has a group of snaraks that live in tandem with them, feeding off of their waste.  In return the goblins can hunt and eat the snaraks as tasty snacks, thus perpetuating the cycle of life.

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobShortDesc: A female goblin peasant is going about her daily chores here.
mobLongDesc: This peasant has lived a happy and ignorant life as a female goblin.  Seldom allowed out of her home cave, this brief treat to see the tunnels that the rest of the tribe lives and works in could be a once in a lifetime experience for her.

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobShortDesc: A male goblin peasant is going about his work here.
mobLongDesc: This peasant appears to be rather content and at peace, if that is possible for a goblin.  He toils along at his duties day-in and day-out for the greater good of his clan.

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobShortDesc: A goblin miner stands here, chipping away at the walls.
mobLongDesc: This miner is still under the illusion that some extraordinary gems or precious metals might still be found in these walls.  The saddening truth is that dwarven miners are not known to leave anything of value behind, even when being chased out of their caves. This poor fellow has a long and pointless existence ahead of him.

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobShortDesc: A goblin sentry is standing about here, lazily performing his duties.
mobLongDesc: The sentry looks bored out of his mind as he stands at his post.  His shoulders are slumped and he seems to have trouble staying awake.  Besides earning a lukewarm meal and a hole to live in, this goblin has little to look forward to as rewards for his lifelong job.

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobShortDesc: An elite goblin guard stands here, keeping watch over his clan's caves.
mobLongDesc: This is one of Clan Kraznor's elite goblin guards.  These are the best-trained and heavily-equipped fighters in all of the clan.  This particular guard is wearing mismatched pieces of studded leather armor that appear to have once been decent gear, but now have begun to rot, even as the goblin wears it.

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobShortDesc: The keeper of the gate stands here, barring your way.
mobLongDesc: The Keeper of the Gate is a truly ominous figure.  He towers over the other goblins of his clan at over a meter and a half tall and is as wide as a moderately-sized barrel.  With a snarl perpetually on his lips, he stands here performing his duty with un-goblin-like zeal.

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobName: Quareen, High Priestess of the Kraznor Clan
mobShortDesc: Quareen, high priestess of the Kraznor Clan, stands here muttering to herself.
mobLongDesc: The high priestess Quareen smiles knowingly to herself.  Apparently this is where the real power of the tribe rests. Utterly ruthless and evil, this priestess kills on a whim and prefers her meals raw and bleeding.

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobShortDesc: Chief Druxlor is here, asleep on his throne.
mobLongDesc: Druxlor the goblin chief is quite a figure.  Standing no more than three and a half feet tall and being nearly as wide, one brings to mind the question of how he became the leader of these smelly creatures.  However, the gleam in his eye and the way he strokes his axe could give some clues...

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobShortDesc: An amorphous mass of green mold oozes about, scouring the floor for food.
mobLongDesc: What can only be described as a mass of dark green mold shuffles about here, sweeping across the floor in its flattened disc-like shape.  The entire surface of its body undulates in a steady pulse, almost as if it were breathing.  A thin trail of spores is left behind in its wake as it moves about from place to place.
mobImmune: POISON PUMMEL SLEEP CHARM BLINDNESS PARALYSIS DISEMBOWEL BACKSTAB

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobShortDesc: A creature composed entirely of sickly yellow-orange pudding meanders about.
mobLongDesc: This foul creature is a sickening conglomeration of some type of yellow-orange pudding-like substance.  Pustules of oozing fluid pop and smear across the gelatinous surface of the thing, leaking out a putrid slew of disgusting matter.  It has no identifiable features, but seems to creep along keeping its body oriented in the same position as much as possible.
mobImmune: ELECTRIC POISON PUMMEL SLEEP CHARM BLINDNESS PARALYSIS DISEMBOWEL BACKSTAB

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobKeywords: muckdweller humanoid creature mud clay muck
mobShortDesc: A small humanoid creature made from mud and clay is here, holding a stone club.
mobLongDesc: This creature, known as a muckdweller, is a short, tough-looking fellow made of mud and clay.  The surface of its 'skin' undulates and flows about its body, as the murky substance it is made from flows about its form.  The creature stands at slightly less than one meter high; however, its solidity and the fact that it is carrying a large staff made of a single shaft of rock makes it look imposing nonetheless.

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobShortDesc: A horridly smelly goblin squats in the filth, muttering to himself.
mobLongDesc: This is Grug, the infamous goblin weapons inventor of the powerful Kraznor Clan.  The poor insane fellow was forced to flee his home caves, though not because his inventions nearly always backfired on their users, killing the lot of them, for that is the goblin way.  Instead, he was forced into exile because he refused to wear proper goblin-issue rags, opting to wear nothing but a loincloth and his very long beard (even goblins have fashion standards).  In lonely desperation, Grug now lives in the filthy caverns below his old home, hiding from the other monsters in the caves and frantically spends his time building new inventions that might one day win back the trust of his clan-mates, and possibly acceptance for his partial-nudity.

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobKeywords: crab giant pale-white pale white subterranean
mobShortDesc: A giant crab with a pale-white carapace scuttles about, clacking its pincers.
mobLongDesc: This is a type of giant crab not found anywhere else in the world.  Countless ages of dwelling underground has transformed these creatures, encouraging adaptation to the harsh environment in order to survive.  The thick armored shell that it wears is ghostly white, disrupted only by thin blue vein-like structures that thread their way along its surface in a myriad of random shapes.  The crab has no visible eye-stalks, instead having two large membranous holes that pulsate and serve some unknown function.  As unusual as this creature is, the general shape of the critter is similar to that of its smaller surface cousins, down to the general design and purpose of its two massive pincers.

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobShortDesc: A large troll is here, diligently tending to his herd of giant crabs.
mobLongDesc: The old crab herder is a large but hunched-over and weary-looking troll who has become a hermit after being cast out of his tribe for a long-forgotten crime. Banished to the underdark, he has taken to herding the giant crabs that dwell there in order to survive.  His great regenerative powers allow him to survive the various nips and bites the crabs often times inflict.  He can often be seen grumbling to himself and singing in a sing-song voice about crabs and the drinking of heavy malt liquor...  Perhaps his mind is not what it used to be.

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobShortDesc: A young black dragon lies curled here, resting in a half-sleep.
mobLongDesc: This is a young dragon by all appearances, yet its youth and inexperience do little to diminish the aura of power and strength that it projects.  Its glistening black scales sparkle with a light that seems almost of their own. Unlike older dragons of its kind, this particular one seems more alert and less lethargic, a product of the creatures youth and desire to grow and conquer. Huge corded muscles ripple beneath the serpentine surface of its body, causing its wings and claws to flex in response.  Though small compared to an adult wyrm, its body is over a dozen meters long and looks to weigh an equal amount in metric tons.
affectedByFlags: DETECT-ALIGNMENT DETECT-INVISIBLE DETECT-MAGIC SENSE-LIFE PROTECT-GOOD DUAL

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobShortDesc: A small pixie is here, flitting about on his iridescent wings.
mobLongDesc: Tilik is a rather mean-spirited prankster, even for one of his own kind.  After stealing the rings off of his pixie prince's fingers and cutting him on each cheek because "blood is funny", Tilik was surprised to find that all of a sudden everyone wanted him locked up or dead.  After countless minutes of teleportative fleeing, lazy Tilik grew bored of that game.  But, curiosity brutally murdered the fairy, as pixies like to say, and he found himself lured into the deep underground caverns below a goblin den.  There he found a nice muddy hole to live in and plenty of shiny trinkets to steal from the treasure piles of nearby denizens of the dark.
actionFlags: SENTINEL SCAVENGER ISNPC NICE-THIEF STAY-ZONE MEMORY
affectedByFlags: DETECT-ALIGNMENT DETECT-INVISIBLE DETECT-MAGIC SANCTUARY INFRAVISION DODGE FLY
attackType: SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST SPELL CAST DISARM

zoneName: Goblin Kingdom and Marsh Cave, by BobaNight
mobShortDesc: The ghastly corpse of a long-dead dwarf shambles about, moaning to itself.
mobLongDesc: The putrid half-decayed form of a dwarven warrior shambles about aimlessly, moaning incomprehensible sounds to the ever-listening dark.  Puss and various types of insects and worms leak out of huge gaping sores that cover this being's taut flesh.  Bits of tattered clothing and armor still cling to their owner, seemingly reluctant to completely fall away even in the face of its death.  Dim crimson light glows from the empty sockets of the zombie's face, their evil intent the only hint of purpose that the ghastly form portrays.
mobImmune: ELECTRIC POISON PUMMEL SLEEP CHARM BLINDNESS PARALYSIS DRAIN DISEMBOWEL BACKSTAB

mobShortDesc: Tregannis the tyrant stands here ready to inflict pain and torture.
mobLongDesc: This short dark man is one of the most vicious in the sultanate. He is the tyrant and the interrogator of all the poor souls who happen to fall into his clutches. He wears tight black leather pants and a black leather vest accompanied by a small black leather mask which covers his eyes.
actionFlags: SENTINEL ISNPC AGGRESSIVE STAY-ZONE MEMORY SHIELD
affectedByFlags: DETECT-INVISIBLE SENSE-LIFE SANCTUARY INFRAVISION DUAL FURY

mobShortDesc: The Grand Vizier sits here writing in his book.
mobLongDesc: You see a small fat and bald man sweating away in the heat. He is the genius who manages all the affairs of the Emir as well as all the trade in and out of Jal-Pur. He wears a simple white robe embroidered with platinum and silver sequins.
actionFlags: SCAVENGER ISNPC AGGRESSIVE STAY-ZONE WIMPY ARM
affectedByFlags: INVISIBLE DETECT-INVISIBLE SENSE-LIFE SANCTUARY INFRAVISION DODGE FURY

mobShortDesc: Malik, the great Emir of Jal-Pur is relaxing here.
mobLongDesc: His eminence the great Emir of the Sultanate is a stocky man with a long and thick moustache drooping over his lips. He wears rings on each of his fingers and a richly fashioned kaftan. He is a great fighter and a benefactor of his people, a just and righteous man.

mobShortDesc: The Guide stands here protecting his blind mistress.
mobLongDesc: You see a tall and well-built wrestler standing guard here. He is a mute who has been chosen to protect the Oracle. He is bald and wears a dress made from the skin of a white panther. He seems to be unaffected by the pain and suffering his mistress is going through.
affectedByFlags: DETECT-INVISIBLE SENSE-LIFE SANCTUARY INFRAVISION DODGE INVUL DUAL FURY

mobShortDesc: The Blind Seeress writhes in agony, in the grip of a powerful vision.
mobLongDesc: You see a frail and sickly woman dressed in rags and other scrapings picked up from the garbage. Her hair is totally disheveled and her face is sticky from her tears. She seems to be laughing and crying at the same time. Between these bouts, she writhes out in agony and screams out her prophecies.

mobShortDesc: The Demon Statue stands here waiting to be worshipped by you !
mobLongDesc: You see a large statue carved from fine red alabaster. The statue of the Demon-God of Jal-Pur stands here in grim silence waiting for worshippers to pay homage to it. The face of the statue is set in a diabolic grin and the eyes seem to follow your every move. Near the feet of the statue you can make out traces of blood and rotting bones and flesh - of humans !

mobShortDesc: A Jal-Purian Bedouin stands here taking care of his business.
mobLongDesc: You see a simple man dressed in white desert robes and a flowing headdress. As he opens his mouth to spit in the sand, you glimpse at his teeth capped with pure gold. He seems to be minding his own business and does not seem to mind the heat nor does he acknowledge your presence.
